en: A nine-year-old was asleep at 2:30 a.m.; drivers saw a child on the highway at 4.
Highway 18, Shelby, North Carolina, February 14, 2000.
zh: 凌晨 2 點半孩子還在睡；4 點時駕駛人看到一個孩子走在公路上。
北卡羅來納州謝爾比 18 號公路，2000 年 2 月 14 日。

en: A motorboat collided with a personal watercraft; two riders died.
Treasure Island, Florida, 2005; charged with boating under the influence.
zh: 一艘汽艇撞上水上摩托車，兩名騎乘者死亡。
佛州金銀島，2005 年；被控酒後駕船。

en: Military officers allegedly targeted Ukraine's infrastructure, a French campaign and Georgia.
Unit 74455; one of six indicted in Pittsburgh, 2020.
zh: 軍官據稱鎖定烏克蘭基礎設施、法國一場競選和喬治亞。
74455 部隊；2020 年在匹茲堡被起訴的六人之一。

en: An estranged spouse was found dead in a car on a rural roadside.
Riverside County, California, June 1997; said to enjoy gambling.
zh: 分居的配偶被發現陳屍在鄉間路肩的車內。
加州河濱郡，1997 年 6 月；據說喜歡賭博。

en: Set out alone with a backpack; the backpack turned up in a ditch.
Eaton, Colorado, January 14, 2024; about a mile from the house.
zh: 獨自背著背包出門；背包後來在一條水溝裡被找到。
科羅拉多州伊頓，2024 年 1 月 14 日；距離住處約一英里。

en: Allegedly raised about $10 million from 400-plus investors, paying early ones with newer funds.
Ran Helios Venture Fund LLC; may be near Puerto Vallarta.
zh: 據稱向 400 多名投資人募得約 1000 萬美元。
經營 Helios Venture Fund LLC；可能在巴亞爾塔港附近。

en: A traffic stop on a car from Arizona turned up about 72 kilograms of pills.
Charged with over 400 grams of fentanyl in Albuquerque; ties to Mazatlán.
zh: 一次臨檢攔下從亞利桑那來的車，查獲約 72 公斤藥丸。
在阿布奎基被控持有逾 400 公克芬太尼；與馬薩特蘭有關聯。

en: A five-year-old was playing in a city park one afternoon.
Bridgeton City Park, behind the high school, New Jersey, September 2019.
zh: 一個五歲孩子某天下午在市立公園玩。
紐澤西州布里奇頓市立公園，高中後方，2019 年 9 月。

en: Hundreds of kilograms moved from Mexico through Los Angeles, bound for Canada.
Charged in January 2024 with importing controlled substances.
zh: 數百公斤貨物從墨西哥經洛杉磯運往加拿大。
2024 年 1 月被控輸入管制物質。

en: Someone was seized at gunpoint on I-20 and released after paying a large sum.
Near Panola Road, Atlanta, August 2026; others involved aren't named.
zh: 有人在 20 號州際公路上被槍抵著擄走，付了一大筆錢後才被放走。
亞特蘭大帕諾拉路附近，2026 年 8 月；其他涉案者身分不明。

en: Allegedly ran a call-center con targeting American timeshare owners in Mexico.
A high-ranking CJNG leader with ties to Jalisco.
zh: 據稱經營電話詐騙中心，鎖定在墨西哥擁有分時度假屋的美國人。
哈利斯科新世代集團（CJNG）的高層領袖，與哈利斯科有關聯。

en: Fake login pages allegedly harvested email passwords to gather U.S. defense insights.
Said to be an FSB officer; charged in San Francisco, 2023.
zh: 據稱以假登入頁面竊取電子郵件密碼，蒐集美國國防資訊。
據稱是聯邦安全局官員；2023 年在舊金山被起訴。

en: A U.S. citizen said to be the highest-ranking American with al-Shabaab.
Served as an instructor at its training camps; raised in San Diego.
zh: 據稱是在青年黨（al-Shabaab）中位階最高的美國公民。
曾在其訓練營擔任教官；在聖地牙哥長大。

en: Posed as remote IT staff for 64 U.S. companies to earn for Pyongyang.
Two people named; April 2018 to August 2024.
zh: 冒充遠端 IT 人員替 64 家美國公司工作，為平壤賺錢。
列名兩人；2018 年 4 月至 2024 年 8 月。

en: Finished a final exam, then never showed up for work or the next exams.
Northeastern State University, Tahlequah, Oklahoma, December 13, 2004.
zh: 考完一場期末考後，就再也沒去上班或參加其他考試。
奧克拉荷馬州塔勒闊東北州立大學，2004 年 12 月 13 日。

en: Checked into army lodging after a trip overseas, then never returned to duty.
Rainier Inn, Fort Lewis, Washington, May 9, 2009.
zh: 出國度假回來後住進軍方旅館，之後再也沒回去上班。
華盛頓州路易斯堡 Rainier Inn，2009 年 5 月 9 日。

en: Two people were killed in Mendota, California, in October 2016.
Charged as killings to advance an organized group; ties to El Salvador.
zh: 2016 年 10 月，兩人在加州門多塔遇害。
被控為了替組織犯罪集團效力而殺人；與薩爾瓦多有關聯。

en: Part of "Los Baja Deo" (Thumbs Down), spread over seven housing projects.
Western Puerto Rico; charged over heroin, cocaine and firearms.
zh: 屬於「Los Baja Deo」（倒讚幫），勢力遍及七個國宅社區。
波多黎各西部；被控涉及海洛因、古柯鹼和槍械。

en: A man in Salem, Oregon, died in 2001 over an unpaid narcotics debt.
Indicted in Marion County; may be with a cousin in Matamoros or Tijuana.
zh: 2001 年奧勒岡州塞勒姆一名男子因毒債喪命。
在馬里昂郡被起訴；可能與表親在馬塔莫羅斯或提華納。

en: Fourteen workers allegedly earned and moved revenue for Pyongyang, 2017 to 2023.
Listed as a group leader; charged in St. Louis.
zh: 十四名工作者據稱在 2017 至 2023 年替平壤賺取並轉移收入。
列為組長；在聖路易被起訴。

en: Had plans to go to a baseball game with parents that afternoon.
Plantation, Florida, September 30, 2000; a car was found days later.
zh: 原本打算當天和父母去看棒球賽。
佛州種植園市，2000 年 9 月 30 日；幾天後找到車子。

en: Allegedly ordered acts of violence as a senior MS-13 leader.
Hollywood clique; led from inside El Salvador's Chalatenango prison.
zh: 據稱以 MS-13 高層身分下令施暴。
好萊塢分支；曾在薩爾瓦多查拉特南戈監獄內坐鎮指揮。

en: Sold controlled substances and carried firearms in East Harlem, 2022–2025.
Warrant issued in Manhattan, December 12, 2025.
zh: 2022 至 2025 年在東哈林區販售管制物質並攜帶槍械。
2025 年 12 月 12 日在曼哈頓發出拘票。

en: An armored car guard outside a movie theater died; the cash was taken.
Phoenix, 2004; speaks French, holds an MBA, loves golf and skiing.
zh: 電影院外的運鈔車警衛喪命，現金被搶走。
鳳凰城，2004 年；會說法語，有企管碩士學位，愛打高爾夫和滑雪。

en: A senior Syrian official accused of cruel treatment of civilian detainees.
Charged with conspiracy to commit war crimes; U.S. citizens were among them.
zh: 一名敘利亞高官，被控殘酷對待平民被拘留者。
被控共謀戰爭罪；受害者包括美國公民。

en: Was at the house around 11 p.m. one August night, then gone.
New Castle, Pennsylvania, August 11, 2013.
zh: 八月某晚約 11 點還在住處，之後就不見了。
賓州新堡，2013 年 8 月 11 日。

en: Set out from Michigan for California on foot.
Ann Arbor, Michigan, December 21, 2013; reported weeks later.
zh: 從密西根徒步出發前往加州。
密西根州安娜堡，2013 年 12 月 21 日；幾週後才報案。

en: Allegedly ran a botnet of thousands of infected machines for profit in 2021.
Monikers "Alipako" and "Uptime"; lives in Chisinau.
zh: 據稱在 2021 年經營由數千台受感染機器組成的殭屍網路牟利。
代號「Alipako」和「Uptime」；住在基希訥烏。

en: Banking trojans allegedly infected tens of thousands of machines, costing tens of millions.
Known as Bugat, Cridex or Dridex; a system administrator.
zh: 銀行木馬據稱感染數萬台機器，造成數千萬美元損失。
人稱 Bugat、Cridex 或 Dridex；擔任系統管理員。

en: Part of an Oklahoma network moving methamphetamine, 2015–2016.
Previously lived in Phoenix; ties to Porterville, California.
zh: 2015 至 2016 年參與奧克拉荷馬州一個運送冰毒的網絡。
曾住鳳凰城；與加州波特維爾有關聯。

en: A Molotov cocktail was thrown at a pregnancy center, caught on surveillance video.
Lincolnton, North Carolina, June 2022; the thrower has not been named.
zh: 有人朝一家懷孕中心丟擲汽油彈，過程被監視器拍下。
北卡羅來納州林肯頓，2022 年 6 月；投擲者身分仍未查明。

en: A spouse helped load a small "Jon" boat into the van for a fishing trip.
Smiths Grove, Kentucky, June 19, 1999.
zh: 配偶幫忙把一艘小型「Jon」船搬上廂型車，準備去釣魚。
肯塔基州史密斯格羅夫，1999 年 6 月 19 日。

en: Allegedly took a Houston firm's coiled tubing secrets, then sold a rival product.
Also known as "Jason"; left the U.S. in 2019 for China.
zh: 據稱竊取休士頓一家公司的連續油管機密，再推出競爭產品。
又名「Jason」；2019 年離美前往中國。

en: Reported the same day as the last sighting, in a state capital.
Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, December 3, 2022.
zh: 在州首府最後一次被看到的當天就有人報案。
賓州哈里斯堡，2022 年 12 月 3 日。

en: Allegedly locked up victims' files and demanded payment, hitting non-profits and infrastructure.
2020–2022, New Jersey indictment; speaks Farsi.
zh: 據稱鎖住受害者的檔案勒索付款，受害者包括非營利組織和基礎設施。
2020 至 2022 年，紐澤西起訴；會說波斯語。

en: Allegedly the financial operator of a call-center con hitting American timeshare owners.
A high-level accountant tied to Mexico's CJNG.
zh: 據稱是專騙美國分時度假屋屋主的電話詐騙中心的財務操盤手。
與墨西哥 CJNG 有關的高階會計。

en: Allegedly ran a call-center con targeting American timeshare owners in Mexico.
Described as a high-ranking CJNG leader; ties to Jalisco.
zh: 據稱經營電話詐騙中心，鎖定在墨西哥擁有分時度假屋的美國人。
被描述為 CJNG 高層領袖；與哈利斯科有關聯。

en: Allegedly stole research from universities and sold it to Tehran.
A contractor for the Mabna Institute; speaks Farsi.
zh: 據稱從大學竊取研究成果並賣給德黑蘭。
Mabna 研究所的承包商；會說波斯語。

en: Front companies allegedly bought tobacco and other goods for Pyongyang.
Allegedly a supervisor; charged in Washington, D.C., March 2023.
zh: 據稱以空殼公司替平壤採購菸草等貨品。
據稱擔任主管；2023 年 3 月在華盛頓特區被起訴。

en: A Colorado building run by Life Choices was vandalized and set on fire.
Longmont, June 25, 2022; investigators want tips on who did it.
zh: 科羅拉多州一棟 Life Choices 的建築遭破壞並被縱火。
朗蒙特，2022 年 6 月 25 日；調查人員徵求線索找出是誰做的。

en: Military officers allegedly targeted Ukraine's infrastructure, a French campaign and Georgia.
Unit 74455; October 15, 2020; last known in Moscow.
zh: 軍官據稱鎖定烏克蘭基礎設施、法國一場競選和喬治亞。
74455 部隊；2020 年 10 月 15 日；最後已知在莫斯科。

en: A St. Petersburg agency allegedly ran fake American personas to sway U.S. politics.
Allegedly used real Americans' details to open PayPal accounts.
zh: 聖彼得堡一家機構據稱經營假美國人身分，企圖左右美國政治。
據稱用真實美國人的資料開立 PayPal 帳戶。

en: Told dozens of investors their cash backed "peer to peer" loans.
At least $10 million lost; the car turned up abandoned in Dunwoody, Georgia.
zh: 告訴數十名投資人，他們的錢投入有擔保的「P2P」借貸。
損失至少 1000 萬美元；所開的車被棄置在喬治亞州鄧伍迪。

en: The car was still parked outside the apartment.
Atlanta, Georgia, March 25, 2012.
zh: 車子仍停在公寓外面。
喬治亞州亞特蘭大，2012 年 3 月 25 日。

en: Out of jail two days, then said nothing about where they were headed.
A parent's house in Taneytown, Maryland, October 25, 2019.
zh: 出獄才兩天，離開時沒說要去哪裡。
馬里蘭州坦尼鎮的父母家，2019 年 10 月 25 日。

en: Allegedly broke into anti-doping agencies and ran disinformation against sports officials.
One of seven indicted in Pittsburgh, October 2018.
zh: 據稱闖入反禁藥機構，並對運動官員進行假訊息操作。
2018 年 10 月在匹茲堡被起訴的七人之一。

en: Fake social media personas allegedly lured current and former U.S. agency staff.
Four people charged in Washington, D.C., 2019.
zh: 據稱以假社群媒體身分引誘美國情報機構現任及前任人員。
2019 年在華盛頓特區被起訴的四人。

en: Sought over a 2017 ambush on a U.S. Special Forces convoy in Niger.
Four American soldiers died near Tongo Tongo; may be on the Mali border.
zh: 因 2017 年在尼日伏擊美國特種部隊車隊一事被找。
四名美軍在通戈通戈附近喪生；可能在馬利邊境。

en: A Guangzhou "security firm" allegedly took 400 GB from finance and engineering firms.
Known as Boyusec; three indicted in Pittsburgh, September 2017.
zh: 廣州一家「資安公司」據稱從金融和工程公司竊取 400 GB 資料。
人稱 Boyusec；三人 2017 年 9 月在匹茲堡被起訴。

en: A six-year-old playing near the house with three older brothers.
South Los Angeles, June 30, 1994.
zh: 一個六歲孩子和三個哥哥在住家附近玩。
洛杉磯南區，1994 年 6 月 30 日。

en: A group allegedly reached huge numbers of Americans to interfere with a presidential race.
Washington, D.C., 2014 to 2018; warrants issued February 2018.
zh: 一群人據稱接觸大量美國人，企圖干預總統大選。
華盛頓特區，2014 至 2018 年；2018 年 2 月發出拘票。

en: Founder of USI-Tech, a network marketing company pitching crypto returns.
Arrested in Miami in December 2023, then broke release conditions.
zh: USI-Tech 的創辦人，一家主打加密貨幣收益的傳銷公司。
2023 年 12 月在邁阿密被捕，之後違反交保條件。

en: A young person who may not be able to find the way back safely alone.
Stafford Court area, Hendersonville, Tennessee, February 2024.
zh: 一名可能無法獨自安全返家的年輕人。
田納西州亨德森維爾 Stafford Court 一帶，2024 年 2 月。

en: A freelance photojournalist taken while reporting in a war zone.
Damascus, Syria, August 13, 2012; worked for CBS and The Washington Post.
zh: 一名在戰區採訪時被擄走的自由攝影記者。
敘利亞大馬士革，2012 年 8 月 13 日；曾為 CBS 和《華盛頓郵報》工作。

en: Former CEO of Bellum Entertainment, accused of using others' identities.
Charged with bank-related crimes in Los Angeles and Orange Counties, 2017–2018.
zh: Bellum Entertainment 前執行長，被控冒用他人身分。
在洛杉磯和橘郡被控銀行相關犯罪，2017 至 2018 年。

en: Two state and local agencies asking for any details about one evening.
Moore, Oklahoma, June 2, 1992.
zh: 州和地方兩個機關請求提供某天晚上的任何細節。
奧克拉荷馬州摩爾，1992 年 6 月 2 日。

en: Seen near a street corner; reported four days later by a parent.
10th Street and Rex Avenue, Joplin, Missouri, July 2018.
zh: 有人在一個街角附近看到；四天後由家長報案。
密蘇里州喬普林第 10 街與 Rex 大道，2018 年 7 月。

en: Accused of hostage taking for the Sinaloa organization.
Indicted in Los Angeles, 2015; may be in Guadalajara or Culiacán.
zh: 被控為錫那羅亞組織擄人勒贖。
2015 年在洛杉磯被起訴；可能在瓜達拉哈拉或庫利亞坎。

en: A man approached a group outside a home and opened fire; one man died.
Union County, New Jersey, 1992; ties to Haiti and the Dominican Republic.
zh: 一名男子走向聚在住家外的一群人並開火；一名男子死亡。
紐澤西州聯合郡，1992 年；與海地和多明尼加有關聯。

en: Fentanyl and meth allegedly packed into fire extinguishers in scrap metal loads.
The route ran from Mexico into the U.S.; warrant from Los Angeles, 2023.
zh: 芬太尼和冰毒據稱被塞進廢金屬貨物裡的滅火器。
路線從墨西哥進入美國；2023 年由洛杉磯發出拘票。

en: A county constable paid to escort a car believed to carry 5 kilos of narcotics.
Also allegedly kept what was found in cars pulled over; Harris County, 2007.
zh: 一名郡治安官收錢護送一輛據信載有 5 公斤毒品的車。
據稱還私吞從攔檢車輛搜到的東西；哈里斯郡，2007 年。

en: Stopped at a small grocery store around 8 a.m.
E.W. Thomas Grocery, Palmyra, Virginia, April 8, 2011.
zh: 早上 8 點左右去了一家小雜貨店。
維吉尼亞州巴爾米拉 E.W. Thomas 雜貨店，2011 年 4 月 8 日。

en: An FBI special agent's badge was taken during a scuffle with federal officers.
Concord, California, June 2025; the person in photos has no name yet.
zh: 與聯邦人員扭打時，一名 FBI 探員的徽章被拿走。
加州康科德，2025 年 6 月；照片中的人尚未確認身分。

en: A sibling called the police two days after the last contact.
Indianapolis, Indiana, July 6, 2004.
zh: 最後聯絡兩天後，一位手足報了警。
印第安納州印第安納波利斯，2004 年 7 月 6 日。

en: A police officer was hit by fire during a late-night traffic stop.
Lincoln City, Oregon, January 2011; said to have survival skills.
zh: 一名警員在深夜臨檢時中彈。
奧勒岡州林肯市，2011 年 1 月；據說具備野外求生技能。

en: Allegedly breached eight email marketing firms and took over a billion addresses.
Ties to Vietnam; once lived in the Netherlands.
zh: 據稱入侵八家電子郵件行銷公司，取得超過十億個地址。
與越南有關聯；曾住在荷蘭。

en: Fentanyl and meth allegedly packed into fire extinguishers in scrap metal loads.
The route ran from Mexico into the U.S.; charged in December 2023.
zh: 芬太尼和冰毒據稱被塞進廢金屬貨物裡的滅火器。
路線從墨西哥進入美國；2023 年 12 月被起訴。

en: A mother and a six-year-old child died in their New Jersey apartment.
Maple Shade, March 2017; believed to have left for India months later.
zh: 一名母親和一名六歲孩童在紐澤西的公寓中喪命。
梅普爾謝德，2017 年 3 月；據信數月後離境前往印度。

en: Allegedly moved cash to undeclared agents of a foreign government for 12 years.
Arrested in Cyprus in June 2010, posted bail and fled.
zh: 據稱 12 年間把現金轉給未申報的外國政府代理人。
2010 年 6 月在賽普勒斯被捕，交保後逃逸。

en: Charged over seventeen arson incidents by a radical domestic cell.
Indicted in Eugene, Oregon, 2006; fluent in Spanish, once vegan.
zh: 因一個激進國內組織的十七起縱火案被起訴。
2006 年在奧勒岡州尤金被起訴；西班牙語流利，曾吃全素。

en: A Singapore trading firm allegedly fulfilled millions in commodity deals for Pyongyang.
Payment sometimes came as bulk cash hand-delivered by North Koreans.
zh: 一家新加坡貿易公司據稱替平壤完成數百萬美元的商品交易。
有時以北韓人親手送來的大筆現金付款。

en: Allegedly ordered acts of violence as a senior MS-13 leader.
An important Park View leader who spent years in Maryland.
zh: 據稱以 MS-13 高層身分下令施暴。
Park View 分支的重要領袖，在馬里蘭待過很長時間。

en: Fourteen workers allegedly earned and moved revenue for Pyongyang, 2017 to 2023.
Eastern District of Missouri; first named of fourteen.
zh: 十四名工作者據稱在 2017 至 2023 年替平壤賺取並轉移收入。
密蘇里東區聯邦法院；十四人中的首位。

en: Allegedly obtained dual-use U.S. technology for Russian military end users.
ARC Electronics case, 2008 to 2012; travels to Thailand.
zh: 據稱為俄羅斯軍方最終用戶取得美國軍民兩用技術。
ARC Electronics 案，2008 至 2012 年；常去泰國。

en: Goes by nicknames like "Salli from the Valley" and "Slim."
Waynesboro, Virginia, November 2020; about 48 at the time.
zh: 有「Salli from the Valley」和「Slim」等綽號。
維吉尼亞州韋恩斯伯勒，2020 年 11 月；當時約 48 歲。

en: No details are known beyond a two-year window; foul play is suspected.
Homestead, Florida, sometime between 1982 and 1984.
zh: 除了一段兩年的時間範圍外毫無線索；疑涉不法。
佛州霍姆斯特德，1982 至 1984 年間。

en: Twelve members of a Mexico-linked network were arrested in Seattle in 2021.
Charged with distributing over 500 grams of cocaine; a restaurant worker.
zh: 2021 年，一個與墨西哥有關的網絡有十二名成員在西雅圖被捕。
被控散布逾 500 公克古柯鹼；餐廳員工。

en: Drove off with two strangers; a later call said they were stranded in Tennessee.
A sibling's house in Sacramento, California, May 31, 2016.
zh: 和兩名陌生人坐車離開；後來一通電話說困在田納西州。
加州沙加緬度的手足家，2016 年 5 月 31 日。

en: Sought over the 2000 attack on a U.S. Navy destroyer in a Yemeni harbor.
The USS Cole, Aden; 17 American sailors died.
zh: 因 2000 年在葉門港口攻擊美國海軍驅逐艦一事被找。
柯爾號，亞丁港；17 名美國水兵喪生。

en: A parent of young children; foul play is suspected.
Ossineke, Michigan, June 8, 2012.
zh: 育有年幼子女的家長；疑涉不法。
密西根州奧西尼克，2012 年 6 月 8 日。

en: Hundreds of kilograms moved from Mexico through Los Angeles, bound for Canada.
One of several charged in Los Angeles, January 2024.
zh: 數百公斤貨物從墨西哥經洛杉磯運往加拿大。
2024 年 1 月在洛杉磯被起訴的數人之一。

en: A passenger jet was seized during a stop in Karachi in 1986.
Pan Am Flight 73; said to be in the Abu Nidal Organization; a heavy smoker.
zh: 1986 年一架客機在喀拉蚩停靠時遭劫持。
泛美 73 號班機；據稱是阿布尼達爾組織成員；菸癮很重。

en: A child's last known image is a social media video at a Chuck E. Cheese.
Possibly Houston, Texas, around April 1, 2016.
zh: 孩子最後已知的影像，是一段在 Chuck E. Cheese 拍的社群影片。
可能在德州休士頓，約 2016 年 4 月 1 日。

en: A state security officer under academic cover allegedly recruited people against America.
An officer of the Ministry of State Security; travels to the Bahamas.
zh: 一名以學術身分掩護的國安官員，據稱招募他人對付美國。
國家安全部官員；常去巴哈馬。

en: A ten-year-old and a three-year-old sibling; a note said they'd gone to a store.
Chicago, Illinois, July 6, 2001; loved to run track and dance.
zh: 一個十歲孩子和三歲的手足；一張字條說兩人去了商店。
伊利諾州芝加哥，2001 年 7 月 6 日；喜歡跑步和跳舞。

en: A solo traveler never boarded the flight from Paris back to the U.S.
Northern Italy, May 9, 2019; a card was last used in Turin.
zh: 一名獨自旅行的人沒搭上從巴黎返美的班機。
義大利北部，2019 年 5 月 9 日；最後一次刷卡在杜林。

en: Fake login pages allegedly harvested email passwords to gather U.S. defense insights.
Tied to an FSB unit known as the "Callisto Group".
zh: 據稱以假登入頁面竊取電子郵件密碼，蒐集美國國防資訊。
與聯邦安全局一個人稱「Callisto Group」的單位有關。

en: Fake ads allegedly scared people into buying over a million bogus software products.
Losses over $100 million; ties to Brazil, Canada and India.
zh: 據稱以假廣告嚇唬民眾購買超過一百萬套假軟體。
損失逾一億美元；與巴西、加拿大和印度有關聯。

en: Four PRC citizens allegedly took research from firms, universities and institutes for years.
Known as APT 40; indicted in San Diego, May 2021.
zh: 四名中國公民據稱多年來竊取企業、大學和研究機構的研究成果。
人稱 APT 40；2021 年 5 月在聖地牙哥被起訴。

en: A tree-cutting business owner seen going on foot from a house.
Greensboro, North Carolina, May 7, 2004.
zh: 一名經營砍樹生意的老闆，被看到徒步從一間房子離開。
北卡羅來納州格林斯伯勒，2004 年 5 月 7 日。

en: Two siblings, nine and ten, waiting at a stop for the school bus.
As Tao village, Saipan, Northern Mariana Islands, May 25, 2011.
zh: 兩名手足，九歲和十歲，在站牌等校車。
北馬利安納群島塞班島 As Tao 村，2011 年 5 月 25 日。

en: Used a front company to win Pentagon contracts for military parts.
Parts were meant for Nimitz- and Ford-class aircraft carriers.
zh: 利用空殼公司拿下美國國防部的軍用零件合約。
零件是給尼米茲級和福特級航空母艦用的。

en: Beat a man believed to be Jewish outside a Cincinnati restaurant.
Convicted under the federal hate crimes act, then never reported to prison.
zh: 在辛辛那提一家餐廳外毆打一名被認為是猶太人的男子。
依聯邦仇恨犯罪法被定罪，卻始終沒有入監服刑。

en: Spoofed emails allegedly tricked over 70 U.S. businesses into wiring payments.
Also ran romance scams on widows; believed in Nigeria.
zh: 據稱以偽造電子郵件騙超過 70 家美國企業匯款。
也對寡婦行騙感情；據信在奈及利亞。

en: Officers of a Chinese military unit allegedly broke into six American companies' networks.
Unit 61398, indicted in Pittsburgh, May 2014; one of five.
zh: 中國一支軍方單位的軍官，據稱侵入六家美國公司的網路。
61398 部隊，2014 年 5 月在匹茲堡被起訴；五人之一。

en: A bank and a bodega in Yonkers were held up on the same day.
McLean and Warburton Avenues, October 14, 2014.
zh: 揚克斯一家銀行和一家雜貨店在同一天遭搶。
麥克林大道和沃伯頓大道，2014 年 10 月 14 日。

en: Part of "Los Baja Deo" (Thumbs Down), spread over seven housing projects.
Western Puerto Rico and five surrounding communities.
zh: 屬於「Los Baja Deo」（倒讚幫），勢力遍及七個國宅社區。
波多黎各西部及周邊五個社區。

en: Military officers allegedly targeted Ukraine's infrastructure, a French campaign and Georgia.
Unit 74455; Western District of Pennsylvania, 2020.
zh: 軍官據稱鎖定烏克蘭基礎設施、法國一場競選和喬治亞。
74455 部隊；賓州西區聯邦法院，2020 年。

en: Convinced distressed homeowners to sign over their houses, promising help.
Pled guilty in 2009 with a spouse, then skipped court; collects Airsoft replicas.
zh: 說服陷入困境的屋主交出房子，聲稱要幫他們改善財務。
2009 年與配偶認罪後沒出庭；收藏 Airsoft 仿真槍。

en: Allegedly filed four false individual returns with the IRS, 2013 to 2016.
Four counts of income tax evasion; resides in Lebanon.
zh: 據稱在 2013 至 2016 年向國稅局申報了四份不實的個人報稅表。
四項逃漏所得稅罪；住在黎巴嫩。

en: A daughter-in-law died in Stony Point, New York, in 2012.
An experienced hunter and outdoorsman, aged 73 at the time.
zh: 2012 年，一名兒媳在紐約州斯托尼波因特喪命。
經驗豐富的獵人兼戶外好手，當時 73 歲。

en: A veteran who has not contacted relatives since one autumn.
Spotsylvania County, Virginia, fall 1993.
zh: 一名退伍軍人，自某年秋天起就沒再聯絡親人。
維吉尼亞州斯波特瑟爾韋尼亞郡，1993 年秋天。

en: Four people jumped out of a van and attacked two men on a street.
Campbell, California, New Year's Day 1999; may be in Aguascalientes.
zh: 四個人從廂型車跳下，在街上攻擊兩名男子。
加州坎貝爾，1999 年元旦；可能在阿瓜斯卡連特斯。

en: Nicknamed "Tank"; seen by relatives on a reservation road.
American Horse Creek Road near Kyle, South Dakota, October 2015.
zh: 綽號「Tank」；親人在保留區的一條路上看到。
南達科他州凱爾附近 American Horse Creek 路，2015 年 10 月。

en: A St. Petersburg agency allegedly ran fake American personas to sway U.S. politics.
Allegedly the primary funder of the Internet Research Agency.
zh: 聖彼得堡一家機構據稱經營假美國人身分，企圖左右美國政治。
據稱是網際網路研究機構的主要金主。

en: No weapon shown, but a teller saw a pocket bulge and handed over cash.
Fled on foot toward a funeral home in Clarksville, Virginia, April 2026.
zh: 沒有亮出武器，但行員看到口袋鼓起，就把現金交了出去。
徒步逃往維吉尼亞州克拉克斯維爾的一家殯儀館方向，2026 年 4 月。

en: Took two dogs out for an evening stroll; the dogs came back.
Benton Township, Michigan, February 15, 2001, between 7 and 8 p.m.
zh: 晚上帶兩隻狗出去散步；狗回來了。
密西根州本頓鎮，2001 年 2 月 15 日晚上 7 至 8 點。

en: Bingo players were told their cash would bring kids to a Shriners hospital.
Hafa Adai Bingo at the Guam Shrine Club, 2015 to 2021.
zh: 賓果玩家被告知，他們的錢會用來送孩子去聖地兄弟會醫院。
關島聖地俱樂部的 Hafa Adai 賓果，2015 至 2021 年。

en: A migrant farm worker charged after a man died in Belle Glade, Florida.
Second-degree charges in Palm Beach County; ties to Brownsville.
zh: 一名季節性農工，在佛州貝爾格萊德一名男子死亡後被起訴。
在棕櫚灘郡被控二級罪名；與布朗斯維爾有關聯。

en: Known to frequent one neighborhood; goes by the nickname "Red."
Duson, Louisiana, around April 30, 2012; the Veazey area of Lafayette.
zh: 常在某個街區出沒；綽號「Red」。
路易斯安那州杜森，約 2012 年 4 月 30 日；拉法葉的 Veazey 一帶。

en: Allegedly stole research from universities and sold it to Tehran.
An associate of the Mabna Institute; New York, 2018.
zh: 據稱從大學竊取研究成果並賣給德黑蘭。
Mabna 研究所的合作者；紐約，2018 年。

en: One of several suppliers of meth and fentanyl out of the L.A. Harbor Area.
Charged in the Central District of California.
zh: 洛杉磯港區冰毒和芬太尼的數名供應者之一。
在加州中區被起訴。

en: Unhoused and known to travel between two Maryland cities.
Wicomico Public Library area, Salisbury, Maryland, July 27, 2023.
zh: 沒有固定住所，常往返馬里蘭州兩座城市。
馬里蘭州索爾斯伯里 Wicomico 公共圖書館一帶，2023 年 7 月 27 日。

en: A parent and two children were seen at a boat harbor.
Ala Wai Boat Harbor, Honolulu, Hawaii, October 2022.
zh: 一位家長和兩個孩子在一處遊艇港被看到。
夏威夷檀香山阿拉威遊艇港，2022 年 10 月。

en: Seen by relatives around 1 a.m.; a green SUV may be involved.
Broken Arrow, Oklahoma, July 10, 2012; a 2002 Chevrolet Tracker.
zh: 親人約凌晨 1 點看到；一輛綠色休旅車可能有關。
奧克拉荷馬州布羅肯阿羅，2012 年 7 月 10 日；一輛 2002 年雪佛蘭 Tracker。

en: A hazardous device was placed at a Black Hills Energy site.
Lexington, Nebraska, September 2024; the FBI asks the public for help.
zh: 有人在 Black Hills Energy 的一處設施放置危險裝置。
內布拉斯加州列剋星頓，2024 年 9 月；FBI 請民眾協助。

en: Allegedly attacked U.S. media and agencies; charged over false reports of an attack.
Syrian Electronic Army, 2011–2014; believed in Damascus.
zh: 據稱攻擊美國媒體和機關；因散布遭攻擊的假消息被起訴。
敘利亞電子軍，2011 至 2014 年；據信在大馬士革。

en: Left a bar around 2:30 a.m.; the car was found abandoned.
Florida Tap Room, Ocoee, Florida, May 27, 2009.
zh: 凌晨 2 點半左右離開酒吧；車子後來被發現遭棄置。
佛州奧科伊 Florida Tap Room 酒吧，2009 年 5 月 27 日。

en: Sought over a January 2008 attack on a Kabul hotel.
A senior leader of the Haqqani network; stays near Miram Shah.
zh: 因 2008 年 1 月喀布爾一家飯店遇襲一事被找。
哈卡尼網絡的高層領袖；待在米蘭沙一帶。

en: Asked a roommate for a pickup if not back soon; the dog is gone too.
Lakeside, Arizona, June 26, 1997; pickup point was Mesa.
zh: 請室友過幾天沒回來就去接；狗也一起不見了。
亞利桑那州雷克賽德，1997 年 6 月 26 日；接人地點在梅薩。

en: Allegedly compromised phone systems to defraud large telecom companies worldwide.
2008–2012; last known in Malaysia; speaks Urdu.
zh: 據稱入侵電話系統，詐騙全球大型電信公司。
2008 至 2012 年；最後已知在馬來西亞；會說烏都語。

en: Someone from Washington state who was in Mexico when contact ended.
Guamúchil, Sinaloa, Mexico, March 29, 2023.
zh: 一名來自華盛頓州的人，失聯時人在墨西哥。
墨西哥錫那羅亞州瓜穆奇爾，2023 年 3 月 29 日。

en: Allegedly breached video game and high-tech firms for a Chengdu group.
Known as APT 41 or BARIUM; indicted August 2019.
zh: 據稱為成都一個團體入侵電玩和高科技公司。
人稱 APT 41 或 BARIUM；2019 年 8 月被起訴。

en: Fourteen workers allegedly earned and moved revenue for Pyongyang, 2017 to 2023.
President of Volasys Silverstar; charged in St. Louis.
zh: 十四名工作者據稱在 2017 至 2023 年替平壤賺取並轉移收入。
Volasys Silverstar 的總裁；在聖路易被起訴。

en: Five members of a Chengdu crew charged across two indictments.
Known as APT 41 and BARIUM; 2019 and 2020.
zh: 成都一夥人中的五名成員，分兩份起訴書被控。
人稱 APT 41 和 BARIUM；2019 及 2020 年。

en: Fourteen people allegedly earned and moved revenue for Pyongyang, 2017 to 2023.
Charged together in St. Louis, Missouri.
zh: 十四人據稱在 2017 至 2023 年替平壤賺取並轉移收入。
在密蘇里州聖路易一併被起訴。

en: Fourteen workers allegedly earned and moved revenue for Pyongyang, 2017 to 2023.
Listed as a delegation leader; charged in St. Louis.
zh: 十四名工作者據稱在 2017 至 2023 年替平壤賺取並轉移收入。
列為代表團團長；在聖路易被起訴。

en: Software secretly captured bank logins, then accounts were drained.
Known as "Zeus"; thought to be in Russia and Ukraine.
zh: 軟體偷偷擷取銀行登入資料，再把帳戶掏空。
人稱「Zeus」；據信在俄羅斯和烏克蘭。

en: A court split parenting time in January 2010; months later, the child was gone.
Allegedly helped take a grandchild from Florida to Abu Dhabi.
zh: 2010 年 1 月法院判雙方分擔照顧，幾個月後孩子就不見了。
據稱協助把孫輩從佛州帶到阿布達比。

en: Fentanyl and meth allegedly packed into fire extinguishers in scrap metal loads.
Smuggled from Mexico; warrant issued December 21, 2023.
zh: 芬太尼和冰毒據稱被塞進廢金屬貨物裡的滅火器。
從墨西哥走私；拘票於 2023 年 12 月 21 日發出。

en: Officers of a Chinese military unit allegedly broke into six American companies' networks.
Unit 61398; 31 counts filed May 1, 2014.
zh: 中國一支軍方單位的軍官，據稱侵入六家美國公司的網路。
61398 部隊；2014 年 5 月 1 日被控 31 項罪名。

en: Helped set up the Electronic Horizons Foundation to aid an extremist group.
Engaged to another wanted person; thought to be in Egypt.
zh: 協助成立「電子地平線基金會」來支援一個極端組織。
與另一名被通緝者訂婚；據信在埃及。

en: Military officers allegedly registered fake domains to interfere with the 2016 U.S. elections.
A colonel and commanding officer of Unit 74455.
zh: 軍官據稱以假資料註冊網域，干預 2016 年美國大選。
74455 部隊的上校指揮官。

en: Allegedly faked a terminal brain cancer to collect from family and friends.
Fifteen counts, covering October 2015 through July 2016.
zh: 據稱假裝罹患末期腦癌，向親友募款。
共十五項罪名，期間為 2015 年 10 月至 2016 年 7 月。

en: Went for a short stroll from a lakeside campground.
Silver Valley Campground, Lake Alpine, Bear Valley, California, July 2016.
zh: 從湖邊營地出去散步一小段。
加州熊谷阿爾派恩湖 Silver Valley 營地，2016 年 7 月。

en: Thousands of investors were cheated in a Pennsylvania-based company's stock.
Lives in Moscow; may hold Russian, Israeli and Ukrainian passports.
zh: 數千名投資人在一家總部位於賓州的公司股票上被騙。
住在莫斯科；可能持有俄羅斯、以色列和烏克蘭護照。

en: Military officers allegedly registered fake domains to interfere with the 2016 U.S. elections.
A senior lieutenant in Unit 26165; one of twelve.
zh: 軍官據稱以假資料註冊網域，干預 2016 年美國大選。
26165 部隊的上尉；十二人之一。

en: Chengdu 404 employees allegedly ran supply-chain attacks on hundreds of firms worldwide.
Known as APT 41; indicted August 2020; ties to Chengdu.
zh: 成都 404 公司員工據稱對全球數百家企業發動供應鏈攻擊。
人稱 APT 41；2020 年 8 月被起訴；與成都有關聯。

en: Got into a small dark car at the east side of an apartment complex.
1601 Allen Lane, Texarkana, Texas, September 4, 2007.
zh: 在公寓社區東側坐上一輛深色小車。
德州特克薩卡納 Allen Lane 1601 號，2007 年 9 月 4 日。

en: Allegedly bought U.S. gear to repair Russian FSB bug-sweeping devices.
CEO of Radiotester; about 14 trips to the U.S. in four years.
zh: 據稱購買美國設備，修理俄羅斯聯邦安全局的反竊聽裝置。
Radiotester 執行長；四年內約 14 次赴美。

en: A parent and young child; the parent didn't show up for a Sam's Club shift.
Valdosta, Georgia, October 14, 2002.
zh: 一位家長和年幼孩子；家長沒去 Sam's Club 上班。
喬治亞州瓦爾多斯塔，2002 年 10 月 14 日。

en: Officials were allegedly sent secretly to the U.S. to pressure a fugitive to return home.
Brooklyn case, October 2022; one of five.
zh: 據稱秘密派官員到美國，施壓一名逃犯回國。
布魯克林案，2022 年 10 月；五人之一。

en: On a family cruise in the Caribbean, gone from the ship by morning.
Rhapsody of the Seas, Aruba to Curaçao, March 24, 1998.
zh: 在加勒比海家族郵輪旅行中，天亮時人已不在船上。
海洋狂想曲號，從阿魯巴駛往古拉索，1998 年 3 月 24 日。

en: A cardiologist who allegedly built and sold file-locking extortion kits.
Tools called "Jigsaw v. 2" and "Thanos"; 2019–2021.
zh: 一名心臟科醫師，據稱製作並販售鎖檔勒索工具。
工具名為「Jigsaw v. 2」和「Thanos」；2019 至 2021 年。

en: A parent and two children were seen at a boat harbor.
Ala Wai Boat Harbor, Honolulu, October 2022; ties to Naples, Florida.
zh: 一位家長和兩個孩子在一處遊艇港被看到。
檀香山阿拉威遊艇港，2022 年 10 月；與佛州那不勒斯有關聯。

en: A 14-year-old painting a friend's bicycle outside home was struck and died.
Sylmar, California, June 2005; may be in Mexico.
zh: 一名 14 歲少年在家門口幫朋友漆腳踏車時中彈身亡。
加州西爾馬，2005 年 6 月；可能在墨西哥。

en: A St. Petersburg agency allegedly ran fake American personas to sway U.S. politics.
Speaks Russian, English and French; ties to Ukraine.
zh: 聖彼得堡一家機構據稱經營假美國人身分，企圖左右美國政治。
會說俄語、英語和法語；與烏克蘭有關聯。

en: Reported five weeks after the last sighting; tips about Lubbock went nowhere.
Snyder, Texas, January 10, 2015.
zh: 最後被看到五週後才報案；關於拉伯克的線報都查無實據。
德州斯奈德，2015 年 1 月 10 日。

en: Drove four blocks after a late shift, parked in the garage and locked up.
Mendota, Illinois, 1:05 a.m., September 21, 1990.
zh: 下晚班後開車四個街口回去，停進車庫並上鎖。
伊利諾州門多塔，1990 年 9 月 21 日凌晨 1:05。

en: Shipped narcotics to New York City from Las Vegas and San Diego.
Skipped a Manhattan trial set for September 2013.
zh: 從拉斯維加斯和聖地牙哥把毒品運到紐約市。
沒出席原定 2013 年 9 月在曼哈頓的審判。

en: Said they were going on foot to a nearby convenience store.
Miami, Florida, September 11, 2019.
zh: 說要走路去附近的便利商店。
佛州邁阿密，2019 年 9 月 11 日。

en: Walked into a KFC in Topeka at night with a pistol and demanded cash.
Spoke English and Spanish; August 2025; still not named.
zh: 晚上持手槍走進托皮卡一家肯德基，要求交出現金。
會說英語和西班牙語；2025 年 8 月；身分仍未查明。

en: Heads Iran's MOIS internal security directorate, tied to lethal plots abroad.
Linked to the Naji Sharifi Zindashti network.
zh: 主管伊朗情報及安全部內部安全局，與海外致命陰謀有關。
與 Naji Sharifi Zindashti 網絡有關。

en: Lied to the FBI and uses multiple aliases and birth dates.
A known Latin Kings member; ties to Connecticut and Puerto Rico.
zh: 對 FBI 說謊，並使用多個化名和出生日期。
已知的拉丁國王成員；與康乃狄克州和波多黎各有關聯。

en: A car salesman was bound at a dealership; the pair drove off in a van.
Highland Park, Illinois, 1980; said to be in the FALN.
zh: 一名汽車業務在車行被綁起來；兩人開著廂型車離去。
伊利諾州海蘭帕克，1980 年；據稱是 FALN 成員。

en: Broke through a wall from a vacant shop to reach a jewelry store.
Cape Coral, Florida, January 2026; staff were held at gunpoint.
zh: 從隔壁空店面打穿牆壁，進入一家珠寶店。
佛州珊瑚角，2026 年 1 月；店員被槍指著。

en: Indicted over a 1996 truck blast at a U.S. military housing complex.
Khobar Towers, Dhahran; said to belong to Saudi Hizballah.
zh: 因 1996 年美軍住宅區的卡車爆炸案被起訴。
沙烏地阿拉伯達蘭的霍巴塔；據稱屬於沙烏地真主黨。

en: May have been driving a greenish-brown full-size station wagon.
St. Joseph, Michigan, November 24, 1977; age 34.
zh: 可能開著一輛綠褐色的大型旅行車。
密西根州聖約瑟夫，1977 年 11 月 24 日；34 歲。

en: A man died in Irvington, New Jersey, in May 2017.
A convicted felon also charged with taking property; ties to Easton, Pennsylvania.
zh: 2017 年 5 月，一名男子在紐澤西州歐文頓喪命。
一名重罪前科犯，也被控搶奪財物；與賓州伊斯頓有關聯。

en: Allegedly ordered acts of violence as a senior MS-13 leader.
Charged with narco-terrorism; activity spans three countries.
zh: 據稱以 MS-13 高層身分下令施暴。
被控毒品恐怖主義；活動橫跨三國。

en: No one has had any contact since early in a November.
Bradenton, Florida, November 2024.
zh: 從某年十一月初起，就沒有人再聯絡上。
佛州布雷登頓，2024 年 11 月。

en: Accused of hostage taking for the Sinaloa organization.
Indicted in Los Angeles, 2015; believed to be in Mexicali.
zh: 被控為錫那羅亞組織擄人勒贖。
2015 年在洛杉磯被起訴；據信在墨西卡利。

en: Military researchers allegedly stole records on about 145 million Americans from a credit bureau.
Equifax, May to July 2017; PLA 54th Research Institute.
zh: 軍方研究人員據稱從一家信用評等機構竊取約 1.45 億美國人的資料。
Equifax，2017 年 5 月至 7 月；解放軍第 54 研究所。

en: A man died during a game of dominoes.
Sacramento County, August 2007; not known to speak Spanish.
zh: 一名男子在玩骨牌遊戲時喪命。
沙加緬度郡，2007 年 8 月；據知不會說西班牙語。

en: Allegedly stole research from universities and sold it to Tehran.
A leader of the Mabna Institute; resides in Iran.
zh: 據稱從大學竊取研究成果並賣給德黑蘭。
Mabna 研究所的領導人；住在伊朗。

en: A Border Patrol agent died near the Mexican border in Campo, California.
Known as "Camello"; one of five men involved, July 2009.
zh: 一名邊境巡邏隊員在加州坎波、靠近墨西哥邊境處殉職。
綽號「Camello」；涉案的五名男子之一，2009 年 7 月。

en: Traveled to Pakistan and Yemen seeking training to fight U.S. soldiers.
Grew up near Boston; may be living in Aleppo, Syria.
zh: 前往巴基斯坦和葉門尋求訓練，要對付美國士兵。
在波士頓附近長大；可能住在敘利亞阿勒坡。

en: A painter who often took long absences, but never collected a final paycheck.
Waco, Texas, August 1, 2012.
zh: 一名常長時間不見人影的油漆工，但從沒領走最後一筆薪水。
德州韋科，2012 年 8 月 1 日。

en: A housemate noticed a week of absence; belongings were still in the apartment.
Ann Arbor, Michigan, January 15, 1978.
zh: 室友發現人已一週不在；個人物品還在公寓裡。
密西根州安娜堡，1978 年 1 月 15 日。

en: A dating couple seen leaving a bar together late one night.
Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, February 19, 2005.
zh: 一對交往中的情侶，深夜被看到一起離開酒吧。
賓州費城，2005 年 2 月 19 日。

en: A married parent of four, gone under suspicious circumstances.
East Gregory Street, Tacoma, Washington, March 28, 2004.
zh: 已婚、育有四個孩子的家長，在可疑情況下不見人影。
華盛頓州塔科馬東格雷戈里街，2004 年 3 月 28 日。

en: Spoofed emails allegedly tricked over 70 U.S. businesses into wiring payments.
Allegedly sent the spoofed emails; believed in Nigeria.
zh: 據稱以偽造電子郵件騙超過 70 家美國企業匯款。
據稱寄出那些偽造電子郵件；據信在奈及利亞。

en: A St. Petersburg agency allegedly ran fake American personas to sway U.S. politics.
Speaks German; ties to the Netherlands.
zh: 聖彼得堡一家機構據稱經營假美國人身分，企圖左右美國政治。
會說德語；與荷蘭有關聯。

en: A court split parenting time in January 2010; months later, the child was gone.
Allegedly took a young daughter from Florida to Abu Dhabi with a grandparent's help.
zh: 2010 年 1 月法院判雙方分擔照顧，幾個月後孩子就不見了。
據稱在一位祖父母協助下，把年幼的女兒從佛州帶到阿布達比。

en: A masked person stepped out of a Lexus SUV and grabbed an armored-car guard's parcel.
Outside a store in Carolina, Puerto Rico, 10:49 a.m., October 2025.
zh: 一名蒙面人從 Lexus 休旅車下來，搶走運鈔車員工的包裹。
波多黎各卡羅萊納一家店外，2025 年 10 月上午 10:49。

en: A parent and two young children drove away from a relative's house at 8 p.m.
Sacramento, California, July 11, 1978.
zh: 一位家長帶著兩個年幼孩子，晚上 8 點從親戚家開車離開。
加州沙加緬度，1978 年 7 月 11 日。

en: Followed out of work by an ex-partner a week after a breakup.
Niles, Michigan, July 21, 1975.
zh: 分手一週後，下班時被前任跟蹤。
密西根州奈爾斯，1975 年 7 月 21 日。

en: Allegedly broke into anti-doping agencies and ran disinformation against sports officials.
Unit 26165; indicted October 3, 2018; Moscow.
zh: 據稱闖入反禁藥機構，並對運動官員進行假訊息操作。
26165 部隊；2018 年 10 月 3 日被起訴；莫斯科。

en: Set out on foot to meet friends for a swim at a cove.
44 Hudson Avenue, Glens Falls, New York, August 18, 1971.
zh: 徒步出門，要和朋友去一處小灣游泳。
紐約州格倫斯福爾斯哈德遜大道 44 號，1971 年 8 月 18 日。

en: The car turned up in another state with the key still in the ignition.
Carrollton, Georgia, September 23, 2009; car found in Chattanooga.
zh: 車子在另一州被找到，鑰匙還插在點火器上。
喬治亞州卡羅頓，2009 年 9 月 23 日；車子在查塔努加找到。

en: Firms posing as pharmacies or chemical suppliers shipped cutting agents to the U.S.
Four people named on one China-linked poster.
zh: 偽裝成藥局或化學品供應商的公司把稀釋劑運往美國。
一張與中國有關的海報上列了四個人。

en: Not seen by relatives since returning from a trip to Florida.
Upper Darby, Pennsylvania, June 2014; reported in August.
zh: 從佛州旅行回來後，親人就再沒見過。
賓州上達比，2014 年 6 月；8 月才報案。

en: A Navy electronic warfare technician whose ship had just come into port.
USS Horne, Naval Base San Diego, June 1991.
zh: 一名海軍電子作戰技術員，所屬艦艇剛返港。
霍恩號，聖地牙哥海軍基地，1991 年 6 月。

en: A plot to lure or seize a dissident living in America and send them to Iran.
Hired a private investigator to watch the target; 2019 onward.
zh: 一場密謀誘騙或擄走一名住在美國的異議人士並送往伊朗的計畫。
雇用私家偵探監視目標；2019 年起。

en: Wallet and belongings were all left behind; worked in the oil field.
Cody, Wyoming, July 16, 2021.
zh: 錢包和隨身物品全都留下；曾在油田工作。
懷俄明州科迪，2021 年 7 月 16 日。

en: Sought over the November 2008 coordinated attacks in Mumbai.
Ten attackers trained by Lashkar-e-Tayyiba; may have had plastic surgery.
zh: 因 2008 年 11 月孟買的連環攻擊被通緝。
十名襲擊者由虔誠軍訓練；可能整過容。

en: Posed as a reform magazine editor while allegedly obstructing a Chinese telecom prosecution.
Allegedly moved about $61,000 in Bitcoin; enjoys painting.
zh: 冒充改革雜誌編輯，據稱同時妨礙對一家中國電信公司的起訴。
據稱轉移約 61,000 美元的比特幣；喜歡畫畫。

en: Allegedly defaced over 1,100 websites with pro-Iranian messages.
Began around September 2018; Massachusetts indictment.
zh: 據稱以親伊朗訊息竄改超過 1,100 個網站。
約 2018 年 9 月開始；麻州起訴。

en: A passenger jet was seized during a stop in Karachi in 1986.
Pan Am Flight 73; said to belong to the Abu Nidal Organization.
zh: 1986 年一架客機在喀拉蚩停靠時遭劫持。
泛美 73 號班機；據稱屬於阿布尼達爾組織。

en: Played frisbee golf with a friend in Michigan, then turned up in Arkansas.
Hickory Hills, Traverse City; West Fork, Arkansas, April 2010.
zh: 在密西根和朋友玩飛盤高爾夫，之後行蹤出現在阿肯色州。
特拉弗斯城 Hickory Hills；阿肯色州西福克，2010 年 4 月。

en: Two children, ages 10 and 7, sought by the FBI's Norfolk office.
James City County, Virginia, August 29, 2014.
zh: 兩個孩子，10 歲和 7 歲，由 FBI 諾福克分局尋找。
維吉尼亞州詹姆斯城郡，2014 年 8 月 29 日。

en: Seen on video stepping off a school bus; the school wasn't told for weeks.
Cornelius, North Carolina, November 21, 2022.
zh: 影片拍到走下校車；學校過了幾週才接獲通報。
北卡羅來納州科尼利厄斯，2022 年 11 月 21 日。

en: Took the kids to a mall store; by 6 a.m. the parent was gone.
Sears at Briarwood Mall, Ann Arbor, Michigan, October 1973.
zh: 帶孩子去購物中心；隔天早上 6 點，家長已經不在了。
密西根州安娜堡 Briarwood 購物中心 Sears，1973 年 10 月。

en: A prison system's food services administrator, accused of taking bribes.
Twenty counts from a grand jury in Eugene, Oregon, 2007.
zh: 一名監獄系統的伙食主管，被控收受賄賂。
2007 年奧勒岡州尤金的大陪審團起訴二十項罪名。

en: Caught on store video, then seen riding a light purple bicycle.
Walmart, Texarkana, Arkansas, October 28, 2024.
zh: 被商店監視器拍到，之後有人看到騎著一台淺紫色腳踏車。
阿肯色州特克薩卡納沃爾瑪，2024 年 10 月 28 日。

en: Six paintings vanished in Dallas while being trucked from Santa Fe to Louisiana.
Around March 26, 2019; the FBI seeks information on the theft.
zh: 六幅畫在從聖塔菲運往路易斯安那途中，於達拉斯被偷。
約 2019 年 3 月 26 日；FBI 徵求這起竊案的線索。

en: Organized a blockchain and cryptocurrency conference held in Pyongyang.
Founder of the Korean Friendship Association; lives in Spain.
zh: 籌辦一場在平壤舉行的區塊鏈與加密貨幣會議。
朝鮮友好協會創辦人；住在西班牙。

en: Photographed with an unidentified man at a hotel one night abroad.
Mezzanine Hotel, Tulum, Mexico, March 30, 2007.
zh: 某晚在國外一家飯店，和一名身分不明男子被拍下合照。
墨西哥圖盧姆 Mezzanine 飯店，2007 年 3 月 30 日。

en: Allegedly broke into anti-doping agencies and ran disinformation against sports officials.
Unit 26165; charges include identity theft.
zh: 據稱闖入反禁藥機構，並對運動官員進行假訊息操作。
26165 部隊；罪名包括身分盜用。

en: A St. Petersburg agency allegedly ran fake American personas to sway U.S. politics.
Also charged with bank fraud; ties to Bulgaria and Azerbaijan.
zh: 聖彼得堡一家機構據稱經營假美國人身分，企圖左右美國政治。
另被控銀行詐欺；與保加利亞和亞塞拜然有關聯。

en: Shortly after takeoff, a passenger was told to pass a note to a flight attendant.
American Airlines Flight 625, New York to the Virgin Islands, 1983.
zh: 起飛後不久，一名乘客被要求把紙條交給空服員。
美國航空 625 號班機，紐約飛維京群島，1983 年。

en: Sought treatment at a reservation medical facility that day.
Sacaton, Arizona, Gila River Indian Reservation, July 22, 2020.
zh: 當天到保留區的一處醫療機構就診。
亞利桑那州薩卡頓，吉拉河印第安保留區，2020 年 7 月 22 日。

en: A passenger jet was seized during a stop in Karachi in 1986.
Pan Am Flight 73; 20 passengers and crew died.
zh: 1986 年一架客機在喀拉蚩停靠時遭劫持。
泛美 73 號班機；20 名乘客和機組員喪生。

en: Nicknamed "Kita"; known to spend time near a bridge by a motel.
Parsons Road and Fitzwater Drive, Salisbury, Maryland, May 2025.
zh: 綽號「Kita」；常在一家汽車旅館旁的橋附近。
馬里蘭州索爾斯伯里 Parsons 路與 Fitzwater 路，2025 年 5 月。

en: Officials were allegedly sent secretly to the U.S. to pressure a fugitive to return home.
Also charged under the Travel Act; one of five.
zh: 據稱秘密派官員到美國，施壓一名逃犯回國。
另依《旅行法》被控；五人之一。

en: A man died in the early hours outside a Culver's restaurant.
Torrance Avenue, Lansing, Illinois, June 2026.
zh: 一名男子凌晨在一家 Culver's 餐廳外喪命。
伊利諾州蘭辛托倫斯大道，2026 年 6 月。

en: Seventeen Christian missionaries, including five children, were held in Haiti.
Led the group Kraze Barye; October 2021.
zh: 十七名基督教傳教士在海地被扣押，其中有五名兒童。
領導 Kraze Barye 組織；2021 年 10 月。

en: Being out of touch with relatives is described as uncharacteristic.
Fort Myers, Florida, January 5, 2017.
zh: 和親人失聯，被形容為很不尋常。
佛州麥爾斯堡，2017 年 1 月 5 日。

en: All belongings were left behind at the house one early evening.
Maple Shade, New Jersey, May 5, 2025.
zh: 某天傍晚，所有隨身物品都留在住處。
紐澤西州梅普爾謝德，2025 年 5 月 5 日。

en: Allegedly led a global organization moving criminal proceeds, working from Beirut.
Twenty-one laundering counts; funds moved through Florida.
zh: 據稱從貝魯特領導一個轉移犯罪所得的全球組織。
二十一項洗錢罪；資金經佛州轉移。

en: Allegedly stole research from 144 U.S. universities for Tehran.
The Mabna Institute; nine indicted February 2018.
zh: 據稱替德黑蘭竊取 144 所美國大學的研究成果。
Mabna 研究所；2018 年 2 月起訴九人。

en: Allegedly distributed methamphetamine and other substances across Central Florida.
Warrant issued in Tampa, December 2025; ties to Atlanta.
zh: 據稱在佛州中部散布冰毒和其他管制物質。
2025 年 12 月在坦帕發出拘票；與亞特蘭大有關聯。

en: A county sheriff's office asking for help after no contact since September.
Huntsville, Arkansas, September 2019.
zh: 郡警長辦公室請求協助，自九月以來毫無聯絡。
阿肯色州亨茨維爾，2019 年 9 月。

en: A Russian buying network allegedly obtained U.S. gear used for hypersonic and nuclear work.
Serniya/Sertal, 2017–2022; advisor to the general director.
zh: 一個俄羅斯採購網據稱取得用於高超音速和核武研發的美國設備。
Serniya/Sertal，2017 至 2022 年；總經理顧問。

en: Five people hit a Las Vegas Boulevard jewelry store and may hold many Rolexes.
May 19, 2016; all five remain unnamed.
zh: 五個人洗劫拉斯維加斯大道一家珠寶店，可能持有大量勞力士。
2016 年 5 月 19 日；五人身分都還沒查明。

en: Tied to an airliner crash in the Everglades that left 110 people dead.
ValuJet Flight 592, 1996; skipped a federal trial and may be in Chile.
zh: 與一起造成 110 人罹難的大沼澤地空難有關。
ValuJet 592 號班機，1996 年；未出席聯邦審判，可能在智利。

en: Allegedly tried to sway a witness in a foreign lobbying case.
A liaison to Ukrainian and Russian politicians; Washington, 2018.
zh: 據稱企圖影響一宗外國遊說案的證人。
烏克蘭和俄羅斯政界人士的聯絡人；華盛頓，2018 年。

en: Shared two children with an ex-spouse, then flew out of JFK with them.
The route ran through Ukraine to Turkey; the children never returned.
zh: 與前配偶共同撫養兩個孩子，卻帶著孩子從甘迺迪機場出境。
路線經烏克蘭飛往土耳其，孩子們再也沒回來。

en: Spoofed emails allegedly tricked over 70 U.S. businesses into wiring payments.
Allegedly supplied hundreds of bank accounts; Nigeria.
zh: 據稱以偽造電子郵件騙超過 70 家美國企業匯款。
據稱提供數百個銀行帳戶；奈及利亞。

en: Bought a few things at the corner store and never came back.
Homestead, Florida, December 6, 1982; ties to Puerto Rico.
zh: 在街角商店買了點東西，之後就沒回來。
佛州霍姆斯特德，1982 年 12 月 6 日；與波多黎各有關聯。

en: Allegedly targeted people tied to the 2024 presidential campaigns for Iran's Revolutionary Guard.
One of three charged in Washington, D.C., September 2024.
zh: 據稱為伊朗革命衛隊鎖定與 2024 年總統競選陣營有關的人。
2024 年 9 月在華盛頓特區被起訴的三人之一。

en: A spouse reported being dropped off at an office on the Fourth of July.
Fort Defiance, Arizona, July 4, 2002; once lived in Navajo, New Mexico.
zh: 配偶報案說，七月四日國慶當天把人送到一間辦公室。
亞利桑那州迪法恩斯堡，2002 年 7 月 4 日；曾住在新墨西哥州納瓦荷。

en: A young child and parent; the parent didn't show up for a Sam's Club shift.
Valdosta, Georgia, October 14, 2002.
zh: 一個年幼孩子和家長；家長沒去 Sam's Club 上班。
喬治亞州瓦爾多斯塔，2002 年 10 月 14 日。

en: Two inseparable best friends, both reported at 8:30 one evening.
Fairfax, Hamilton County, Ohio, October 15, 1964.
zh: 兩個形影不離的好朋友，某晚 8 點半同時被通報。
俄亥俄州漢密爾頓郡費爾法克斯，1964 年 10 月 15 日。

en: Military officers allegedly targeted Ukraine's infrastructure, a French campaign and Georgia.
Unit 74455; charges include false domain name registration.
zh: 軍官據稱鎖定烏克蘭基礎設施、法國一場競選和喬治亞。
74455 部隊；罪名包括以不實資料註冊網域。

en: A 19-year-old whose daily routine was the two-block trip to the parents' house.
Geneva, Alabama, September 8, 2011.
zh: 一名 19 歲年輕人，每天的例行公事就是走兩個街口去父母家。
阿拉巴馬州日內瓦，2011 年 9 月 8 日。

en: Three siblings allegedly ran eleven Miami-Dade clinics through straw owners.
Medicare was billed for multi-million-dollar kickback claims, 2001–2004.
zh: 三兄弟據稱透過人頭負責人經營邁阿密戴德的十一家診所。
2001 至 2004 年向聯邦醫療保險申報數百萬美元的回扣帳款。

en: A state security officer under academic cover allegedly recruited people against America.
One of four charged in October 2022; travels to Europe.
zh: 一名以學術身分掩護的國安官員，據稱招募他人對付美國。
2022 年 10 月被起訴的四人之一；常去歐洲。

en: Due in court the next day in a case to regain the children.
Ann Arbor, Michigan, September 18, 1958.
zh: 隔天原本要出庭，爭取孩子的監護。
密西根州安娜堡，1958 年 9 月 18 日。

en: Seen by neighbors leaving an apartment with a six-year-old and an ex-spouse.
Parkersburg, West Virginia, 11 a.m., February 3, 2009.
zh: 鄰居看到帶著六歲孩子和前配偶離開公寓。
西維吉尼亞州帕克斯堡，2009 年 2 月 3 日上午 11 點。

en: Sought over a retired FBI agent who went to Kish Island and never returned.
An official of Iran's MOIS, tied to an alleged cover-up.
zh: 因一名退休 FBI 探員前往基什島後再也沒回來而被找。
伊朗情報及安全部官員，涉及據稱的掩蓋行為。

en: Walked away from a federal prison partway through an 11-year sentence.
FCI Jesup, Georgia, the afternoon of May 26, 2026.
zh: 服十一年多的刑期中途從聯邦監獄脫逃。
喬治亞州傑瑟普聯邦懲教所，2026 年 5 月 26 日下午。

en: Three relatives died in an ex-spouse's apartment in Portland, Oregon.
August 1989; ties to Glendale Heights, Illinois, and Guatemala.
zh: 三名親屬在奧勒岡州波特蘭前配偶的公寓中喪命。
1989 年 8 月；與伊利諾州格倫代爾高地和瓜地馬拉有關聯。

en: A new parent who was enrolling in college, seen leaving an apartment.
85 Academy Street, Auburn, Maine, June 2021.
zh: 剛當家長、正在辦大學入學，被看到離開公寓。
緬因州奧本學院街 85 號，2021 年 6 月。

en: A man was struck by fire outside a store in Enid, Oklahoma.
May 2024; also accused of taking a vehicle.
zh: 一名男子在奧克拉荷馬州伊尼德一家店外中彈。
2024 年 5 月；也被控偷車。

en: Posed as remote IT staff for 64 U.S. companies to earn for Pyongyang.
Charges include mail fraud; one of two.
zh: 冒充遠端 IT 人員替 64 家美國公司工作，為平壤賺錢。
罪名包括郵件詐欺；兩人之一。

en: Fake social media personas allegedly lured current and former U.S. agency staff.
Allegedly ran the false personas; speaks Farsi.
zh: 據稱以假社群媒體身分引誘美國情報機構現任及前任人員。
據稱經營那些假身分；會說波斯語。

en: After an argument, a man died; the person sought then took a train to Stamford.
New Rochelle, New York, October 2022; ties to Charlotte and Atlanta.
zh: 一場口角後一名男子喪命；被通緝者隨後搭火車到斯坦福。
紐約州新羅謝爾，2022 年 10 月；與夏洛特和亞特蘭大有關聯。

en: A fight at a party spilled into the street; one man died.
Pico Rivera, California, July 2006; may be in Mexico.
zh: 派對上的打架延燒到街上；一名男子喪命。
加州皮科里維拉，2006 年 7 月；可能在墨西哥。

en: Seen at a relative's house on a reservation late one October night.
Garryowen, Montana, Crow Indian Reservation, October 6, 2024.
zh: 十月某天深夜在保留區的親戚家被看到。
蒙大拿州蓋瑞歐文，克羅印第安保留區，2024 年 10 月 6 日。

en: The FBI and a county sheriff are seeking any information from the public.
A house in Covelo, Mendocino County, California, February 8, 2018.
zh: FBI 和郡警長正向民眾徵求任何資訊。
加州門多西諾郡科韋洛一間房子，2018 年 2 月 8 日。

en: A spouse said goodbye at 9:45 a.m.; the 4:30 shift never happened.
Clarksville Wal-Mart, Tennessee, March 17, 1998.
zh: 配偶早上 9 點 45 分道別；下午 4 點半的班始終沒出現。
田納西州克拉克斯維爾沃爾瑪，1998 年 3 月 17 日。

en: Allegedly ordered acts of violence as a senior MS-13 leader.
A member of the Centrales clique who led U.S. operations.
zh: 據稱以 MS-13 高層身分下令施暴。
Centrales 分支成員，主導美國境內行動。

en: The name on the poster may itself have been an assumed identity.
Sheridan, Indiana, Thanksgiving Day, November 26, 1992.
zh: 海報上的名字本身可能就是化名。
印第安納州謝里登，1992 年 11 月 26 日感恩節。

en: A child known for wearing a silver chain with a turquoise cross.
Gallup, New Mexico, April 6, 1986.
zh: 一個常戴著綠松石十字架銀鍊的孩子。
新墨西哥州蓋洛普，1986 年 4 月 6 日。

en: Friends left the person at an apartment while they went out drinking.
Apartment C, 2120 Belmont Boulevard, Nashville, April 24, 1983.
zh: 朋友們出去喝酒時，把人留在一間公寓裡。
納什維爾貝爾蒙特大道 2120 號 C 室，1983 年 4 月 24 日。

en: Charged with a single count: distribution of methamphetamine.
Warrant issued in Los Angeles, June 2024; born in 1998.
zh: 只被控一項罪名：散布冰毒。
2024 年 6 月在洛杉磯發出拘票；1998 年出生。

en: A threat was scrawled on the lavatory door of an Allegiant flight.
Flight #2006, Clearwater to Cincinnati, April 2025; the writer isn't known.
zh: 有人在 Allegiant 航班的廁所門上寫下威脅字句。
2006 號班機，克利爾沃特飛辛辛那提，2025 年 4 月；寫字的人不明。

en: Was staying in temporary housing with roommates.
735 Broadway Street, Lowell, Massachusetts, January 2, 2025.
zh: 當時和室友住在臨時住所。
麻州洛厄爾百老匯街 735 號，2025 年 1 月 2 日。

en: Spearphishing emails and social engineering allegedly targeted U.S. companies and agencies.
May 2017 to October 2021; speaks Farsi.
zh: 據稱以魚叉式釣魚郵件和社交工程鎖定美國公司與機關。
2017 年 5 月至 2021 年 10 月；會說波斯語。

en: About two dozen Florida companies sold real estate investments to Americans and Europeans.
Sky Development Group; the couple fled to Moscow in 2006.
zh: 約二十多家佛州公司向美國人和歐洲人推銷房地產投資。
Sky Development Group；這對夫妻 2006 年逃往莫斯科。

en: Unhoused and camping in the woods; records hint at later travel out west.
Homestead, Florida, April 1, 1989; originally from Lexington, Kentucky.
zh: 無家可歸、住在樹林裡；紀錄顯示之後可能往西部去了。
佛州霍姆斯特德，1989 年 4 月 1 日；原籍肯塔基州列星頓。

en: Someone appeared to point a pistol at federal officers and possibly fire.
Camarillo, California, July 10, 2025; photos released to the public.
zh: 有人似乎拿手槍對準聯邦執法人員，可能還開了槍。
加州卡馬里奧，2025 年 7 月 10 日；已對外公布照片。

en: Nicknamed "Runny"; spotted at two South Side street corners.
87th and Cottage Grove, Chicago, December 13, 2002.
zh: 綽號「Runny」；有人在南區兩個街角看到。
芝加哥第 87 街與 Cottage Grove，2002 年 12 月 13 日。

en: A founder and spiritual leader of a Palestinian militant faction.
Palestinian Islamic Jihad; studied in Cairo, served as an imam in Gaza.
zh: 一個巴勒斯坦武裝派系的創始人兼精神領袖。
巴勒斯坦伊斯蘭聖戰組織；在開羅求學，曾在加薩擔任伊瑪目。

en: Stepped off the school bus at 2:44 p.m.
Spring, Texas, April 26, 2010; Harris County Sheriff's Office.
zh: 下午 2 點 44 分走下校車。
德州斯普林，2010 年 4 月 26 日；哈里斯郡警長辦公室。

en: A young child at an apartment complex playground one afternoon.
Villas Del Cabo, Fredericksburg Road, San Antonio, December 20, 2021.
zh: 一個年幼孩子某天下午在公寓社區遊樂場。
聖安東尼奧 Fredericksburg 路 Villas Del Cabo，2021 年 12 月 20 日。

en: Three siblings allegedly ran eleven Miami-Dade clinics through straw owners.
Medicare kickback claims, 2001–2004; walks with a limp.
zh: 三兄弟據稱透過人頭負責人經營邁阿密戴德的十一家診所。
2001 至 2004 年的聯邦醫療保險回扣帳款；走路跛腳。

en: State-backed programmers allegedly behind some of the costliest breaches in history.
A North Korean programmer; reported birth years 1984 and 1981.
zh: 據稱是史上損失最慘重入侵事件背後的國家支持程式設計師。
北韓程式設計師；報稱出生年為 1984 和 1981。

en: Allegedly stole research from universities and sold it to Tehran.
A leader of the Mabna Institute; charged 2018.
zh: 據稱從大學竊取研究成果並賣給德黑蘭。
Mabna 研究所的領導人；2018 年被起訴。

en: Allegedly delivered U.S. national defense information to Tehran's government.
Indicted February 2019; believed to live in Iran; speaks Farsi.
zh: 據稱把美國國防資訊交給德黑蘭政府。
2019 年 2 月被起訴；據信住在伊朗；會說波斯語。

en: Leads an organization said to have moved over 14 tons of marijuana into the U.S.
Believed to have had plastic surgery.
zh: 領導的組織據稱把超過 14 噸大麻運進美國。
據信整過容。

en: A spouse came back from work to find every belonging still in the house.
Baroda, Michigan, July 20, 1976.
zh: 配偶下班回來，發現所有物品都還在屋裡。
密西根州巴羅達，1976 年 7 月 20 日。

en: Officers of a Chinese military unit allegedly broke into six American companies' networks.
Unit 61398; victims were negotiating deals with Chinese firms.
zh: 中國一支軍方單位的軍官，據稱侵入六家美國公司的網路。
61398 部隊；受害公司當時正與中國企業談生意。

en: Sought over the 1998 blasts at two U.S. embassies in East Africa.
Dar es Salaam and Nairobi; said to lead the Hittin Committee from Iran.
zh: 因 1998 年東非兩座美國大使館爆炸案被通緝。
三蘭港和奈洛比；據稱在伊朗領導 Hittin 委員會。

en: A camera recorded someone setting fire to parked vehicles after midnight.
Clayton, Missouri, August 2025; investigated as a hate crime.
zh: 監視器拍到有人在午夜後對停放的車輛縱火。
密蘇里州克萊頓，2025 年 8 月；以仇恨犯罪偵辦。

en: Set out for a 7 p.m. stroll to meet someone never identified.
Park Forest, Illinois, Sunday, August 16, 2015.
zh: 晚上 7 點出門散步，要去見一個身分始終不明的人。
伊利諾州帕克福里斯特，2015 年 8 月 16 日星期日。

en: A U.S. citizen taken by force from a house in Mexico.
Pueblo Nuevo, Colima, Mexico, February 9, 2023.
zh: 一名美國公民在墨西哥的住處被強行帶走。
墨西哥科利馬州新普韋布洛，2023 年 2 月 9 日。

en: Military officers allegedly registered fake domains to interfere with the 2016 U.S. elections.
A supervisor in Unit 74455; indicted July 2018.
zh: 軍官據稱以假資料註冊網域，干預 2016 年美國大選。
74455 部隊的主管；2018 年 7 月被起訴。

en: A plot to lure or seize a dissident living in America and send them to Iran.
One of four charged in New York; resides in Iran.
zh: 一場密謀誘騙或擄走一名住在美國的異議人士並送往伊朗的計畫。
在紐約被起訴的四人之一；住在伊朗。

en: As the housing market fell, relatives were recruited as straw buyers.
California homes built and sold, 2006–2008; thought to be in Ukraine.
zh: 房市下跌時，招募親戚當人頭買家。
2006 至 2008 年在加州蓋房賣房；據信在烏克蘭。

en: Allegedly locked the networks of over 250 U.S. companies for payment.
Variants LockerGoga, MegaCortex and Nefilim, 2018 to 2021.
zh: 據稱鎖住超過 250 家美國公司的網路以勒索付款。
變種包括 LockerGoga、MegaCortex 和 Nefilim，2018 至 2021 年。

en: Several rounds fired at a man in a big outdoor shopping center.
Sylmar, next to Los Angeles, August 2019; the victim died.
zh: 在一處大型露天購物中心向一名男子連開數槍。
洛杉磯旁的西爾馬，2019 年 8 月；被害人死亡。

en: A string of store holdups began at a Starbucks; cash went into a brown paper bag.
Riverview and Sun City, Florida, December 2025 to January 2026.
zh: 一連串商店搶案從一家星巴克開始；現金被裝進牛皮紙袋。
佛州里弗維尤和太陽城，2025 年 12 月至 2026 年 1 月。

en: Two people were killed in Mendota, California, in October 2016.
Charged as killings to advance an organized group; ties to El Salvador.
zh: 2016 年 10 月，兩人在加州門多塔遇害。
被控為了替組織犯罪集團效力而殺人；與薩爾瓦多有關聯。

en: An 18-year-old working at a mall coffee shop after a first year of college.
Crocker Galleria, San Francisco, June 23, 1997.
zh: 一名 18 歲大一生，暑假在購物中心咖啡店打工。
舊金山 Crocker Galleria，1997 年 6 月 23 日。

en: Took a bus to meet someone who advertised a babysitting job.
Burlington, New Jersey, June 24, 1974; "John Marshall."
zh: 搭公車去見一個刊登保母工作廣告的人。
紐澤西州柏靈頓，1974 年 6 月 24 日；「John Marshall」。

en: Went off on foot from the scene of a car crash.
South 20th Street and Webster Avenue, Waco, Texas, November 2014.
zh: 從車禍現場徒步離開。
德州韋科南 20 街與 Webster 大道，2014 年 11 月。

en: A failed holdup at the Route 66 Travel Center off I-40, Exit 140.
Pueblo of Laguna lands near Albuquerque, August 2025.
zh: 40 號州際公路 140 號出口旁 Route 66 旅行中心的一起未遂搶案。
阿布奎基附近的拉古納普韋布洛保留區，2025 年 8 月。

en: A co-worker died in the parking lot of an industrial company.
Albertville, Alabama, June 1999; a welder and machinist.
zh: 一名同事在一家工業公司的停車場喪命。
阿拉巴馬州阿爾伯特維爾，1999 年 6 月；焊工兼機械工。

en: Went out for a stroll with a cane and didn't return.
Jonesboro, Georgia, March 10, 2022.
zh: 拄著拐杖出門散步，沒有回來。
喬治亞州瓊斯伯勒，2022 年 3 月 10 日。

en: Several people allegedly gave material support to a group based in Somalia.
The group is al-Shabaab; the case is run from Minneapolis.
zh: 數人據稱向一個以索馬利亞為基地的組織提供物資支援。
該組織是青年黨（al-Shabaab）；案件由明尼亞波利斯負責。

en: One of 23 people charged after a 2004 Chicago-area narcotics inquiry.
Also charged with laundering; may be traveling with family.
zh: 2004 年芝加哥地區一項毒品調查後被起訴的 23 人之一。
也被控洗錢；可能與家人同行。

en: Chengdu 404 employees allegedly ran supply-chain attacks on hundreds of firms worldwide.
Known as APT 41; one of three indicted August 11, 2020.
zh: 成都 404 公司員工據稱對全球數百家企業發動供應鏈攻擊。
人稱 APT 41；2020 年 8 月 11 日被起訴的三人之一。

en: Two long-time friends allegedly aimed pistols at a bank's customers and staff.
Tonawanda, New York, January 2016; may have gone to Pakistan.
zh: 兩名多年好友據稱拿手槍對準銀行顧客和員工。
紐約州托納萬達，2016 年 1 月；可能去了巴基斯坦。

en: Allegedly directed a plot against a U.S. lawyer and activist on American soil.
An advance of $15,000 cash was delivered in New York; alias "Amanat".
zh: 據稱策劃在美國本土對付一名美國律師兼社運人士。
在紐約交付 15,000 美元現金訂金；化名「Amanat」。

en: Software secretly captured bank logins, then accounts were drained.
Zeus; monikers "lucky12345" and "slavik"; lives in Anapa.
zh: 軟體偷偷擷取銀行登入資料，再把帳戶掏空。
Zeus；代號「lucky12345」和「slavik」；住在阿納帕。

en: Hundreds of kilograms moved from Mexico through Los Angeles, bound for Canada.
Charged in January 2024 with distributing controlled substances.
zh: 數百公斤貨物從墨西哥經洛杉磯運往加拿大。
2024 年 1 月被控散布管制物質。

en: Moved from El Paso to Orlando to live with a spouse's parents.
Orlando, Florida, November 2017; holds a South Korean passport.
zh: 從艾爾帕索搬到奧蘭多，和配偶的父母同住。
佛州奧蘭多，2017 年 11 月；持南韓護照。

en: An argument at a store with two men ended with one dead.
California, May 2010; a concrete mason who lived in Baldwin Park.
zh: 在一家店裡與兩名男子起口角，最後一人喪命。
加州，2010 年 5 月；混凝土工，曾住鮑德溫公園。

en: A bystander tried to help a 19-year-old being forced into a hotel room.
November 2007; works in construction; ties to Palm Springs and Houston.
zh: 一名路人試圖幫助一名被強拉進飯店房間的 19 歲女子。
2007 年 11 月；從事營建；與棕櫚泉和休士頓有關聯。

en: Charged over a 2001 suicide attack at a Jerusalem pizza restaurant.
Sixteen people died; once worked as a journalist.
zh: 因 2001 年耶路撒冷一家披薩店的自殺攻擊被起訴。
十六人喪生；曾當過記者。

en: Incendiary devices were placed on ballot drop boxes before dawn.
Vancouver, Washington, and Portland, Oregon, October 2024.
zh: 有人在天亮前把燃燒裝置放在選票投遞箱上。
華盛頓州溫哥華和奧勒岡州波特蘭，2024 年 10 月。

en: A car was taken from its driver near SW North River Drive in Miami.
November 26, 2024; the FBI wants information from the public.
zh: 邁阿密 SW North River Drive 附近，有人從駕駛手中奪走車輛。
2024 年 11 月 26 日；FBI 向民眾徵求資訊。

en: A crowd of 400–500 broke windows at a Federal Building and threw rocks.
Eugene, Oregon, January 30, 2026; people in photos are being sought.
zh: 四五百人的群眾砸破聯邦大樓的窗戶並丟石頭。
奧勒岡州尤金，2026 年 1 月 30 日；正在尋找照片中的人。

en: Allegedly stole research from universities and sold it to Tehran.
An associate of the Mabna Institute; resides in Iran.
zh: 據稱從大學竊取研究成果並賣給德黑蘭。
Mabna 研究所的合作者；住在伊朗。

en: Overnight, a synagogue's main sign and two banners were defaced.
Shaare Tefila Synagogue in Olney, Maryland, February 2026.
zh: 一夜之間，一座猶太會堂的主招牌和兩幅布條遭到破壞。
馬里蘭州奧爾尼的 Shaare Tefila 猶太會堂，2026 年 2 月。

en: A banker for Pyongyang allegedly kept U.S. dollar payments flowing for a decade.
Works for North Korea's Foreign Trade Bank; March 2023.
zh: 替平壤工作的銀行人員，據稱十年來讓美元款項持續流通。
在北韓對外貿易銀行工作；2023 年 3 月。

en: Raised about $35 million for Starclub, an app for influencers.
Investors were allegedly deceived, 2014–2017; possibly near Munich.
zh: 為網紅應用程式 Starclub 募得約 3500 萬美元。
投資人據稱被騙，2014 至 2017 年；可能在慕尼黑附近。

en: Lived alone; the car is gone too, a 2014 dark purple Nissan Juke.
Brookfield, Illinois, September 25, 2019.
zh: 獨居；車子也不見了，是一輛 2014 年深紫色日產 Juke。
伊利諾州布魯克菲爾德，2019 年 9 月 25 日。

en: A 25-year-old seen in the front yard at 10:30 one Friday night.
Fort Hood, Texas, October 1992.
zh: 一名 25 歲的人，某個星期五晚上 10 點半在前院被看到。
德州胡德堡，1992 年 10 月。

en: An Arkansas resident visiting a partner in Mexico, driving a silver Nissan Maxima.
Monterrey or Nuevo Laredo, Mexico, March 29, 2021.
zh: 一名阿肯色州居民開著銀色日產 Maxima 去墨西哥探望伴侶。
墨西哥蒙特雷或新拉雷多，2021 年 3 月 29 日。

en: Indicted in Puerto Rico in 2026, including for misbranding medical devices.
Seen at the Costa Rica–Nicaragua border in July 2026.
zh: 2026 年在波多黎各被起訴，包括醫療器材標示不實。
2026 年 7 月在哥斯大黎加與尼加拉瓜邊境被看到。

en: Held up a bottle of liquid and a lighter mid-flight, demanding to go to Cuba.
Eastern Airlines Flight 161, New York to Tampa, 1980.
zh: 飛行途中拿出一瓶液體和打火機，要求飛往古巴。
東方航空 161 號班機，紐約飛坦帕，1980 年。

en: Indicted over the June 1985 seizure of a commercial airliner.
One U.S. citizen died; said to be in Lebanese Hizballah.
zh: 因 1985 年 6 月劫持一架民航客機被起訴。
一名美國公民喪生；據稱是黎巴嫩真主黨成員。

en: A five-month-old became unresponsive during a babysitting arrangement.
Sandy Springs, Georgia, October 2012; charged with felony cruelty to children.
zh: 一名五個月大的嬰兒在保母照顧期間失去反應。
喬治亞州桑迪斯普林斯，2012 年 10 月；被控重罪虐童。

en: Allegedly helped Beijing's security services cut off or expose U.S. users' accounts.
January 2019 to November 2020; Brooklyn warrant.
zh: 據稱協助北京安全部門關閉或揭露美國用戶的帳號。
2019 年 1 月至 2020 年 11 月；布魯克林發出拘票。

en: Friends dropped the person off at the house; foul play is suspected.
Bountiful, Utah, June 20, 1993.
zh: 朋友把人送到住處門口；疑涉不法。
猶他州邦蒂富爾，1993 年 6 月 20 日。

en: An older resident gone from a foothills neighborhood; the FBI and sheriff are investigating.
Catalina Foothills, Tucson, Arizona, January 31, 2026.
zh: 一位年長居民從山麓社區不見了；FBI 和警長正在調查。
亞利桑那州土桑卡塔利娜山麓，2026 年 1 月 31 日。

en: A violin made in 1710 by Amati was taken from a Los Angeles home.
Los Feliz, December 2020; the FBI Art Crime Team is on it.
zh: 一把 1710 年的 Amati 小提琴從洛杉磯一戶住家被偷。
洛斯費利斯，2020 年 12 月；由 FBI 藝術犯罪小組偵辦。

en: Wanted over the February 1993 blast beneath the World Trade Center.
Six people died in New York City; has epilepsy.
zh: 因 1993 年 2 月世貿中心地下的爆炸案被通緝。
紐約市六人喪生；患有癲癇。

en: Fourteen workers allegedly earned and moved revenue for Pyongyang, 2017 to 2023.
Listed as a group leader; charged in St. Louis.
zh: 十四名工作者據稱在 2017 至 2023 年替平壤賺取並轉移收入。
列為組長；在聖路易被起訴。

en: Two teenage schoolmates, not even friends, may have skipped school together.
Oscoda, Michigan, Halloween 1969.
zh: 兩名十幾歲的同學，甚至不算朋友，可能一起翹課。
密西根州奧斯科達，1969 年萬聖節。

en: Was expected at an aunt's house but never arrived.
Nashville, Tennessee, May 1, 1989; reported by a sibling.
zh: 原本該到阿姨家，卻始終沒到。
田納西州納什維爾，1989 年 5 月 1 日；由手足報案。

en: The red Plymouth Neon was later recovered at an apartment complex.
Nashville, Tennessee, June 8, 1998; Michigan plate PEX755.
zh: 那輛紅色 Plymouth Neon 後來在一處公寓社區被找回。
田納西州納什維爾，1998 年 6 月 8 日；密西根車牌 PEX755。

en: A 12-year-old and a 17-year-old gone from a state school campus.
New Lisbon State School, Burlington County, New Jersey, April 7, 1975.
zh: 一個 12 歲和一個 17 歲的孩子，從一所州立學校校園不見了。
紐澤西州柏靈頓郡新里斯本州立學校，1975 年 4 月 7 日。

en: May have gone off with a long-haul truck driver.
Weldon, North Carolina, June 24, 2013.
zh: 可能跟著一名長途卡車司機離開。
北卡羅來納州韋爾登，2013 年 6 月 24 日。

en: Military officers allegedly registered fake domains to interfere with the 2016 U.S. elections.
Unit 74455; also charged with wire fraud.
zh: 軍官據稱以假資料註冊網域，干預 2016 年美國大選。
74455 部隊；另被控電匯詐欺。

en: A hospital food-service worker waiting at a bus stop after a shift.
Bryn Mawr Hospital, Pennsylvania, May 22, 1989.
zh: 一名醫院餐飲部員工，下班後在公車站等車。
賓州布林莫爾醫院，1989 年 5 月 22 日。

en: An 18-year-old, seen in a small South Carolina city just before Thanksgiving.
Rock Hill, South Carolina, November 25, 2014.
zh: 一名 18 歲年輕人，感恩節前夕在南卡一座小城被看到。
南卡羅來納州羅克希爾，2014 年 11 月 25 日。

en: A man parked a distinctively damaged silver Honda Accord, then vandalized a mosque.
Baitus Samee Mosque, Houston, August 2024.
zh: 一名男子停好一輛有明顯損傷的銀色本田雅哥，接著破壞清真寺。
休士頓 Baitus Samee 清真寺，2024 年 8 月。

en: A 17-year-old and a 12-year-old gone from a state school campus.
New Lisbon State School, 1,896 acres, Burlington County, April 1975.
zh: 一個 17 歲和一個 12 歲的孩子，從一所州立學校校園不見了。
佔地 1,896 英畝的新里斯本州立學校，柏靈頓郡，1975 年 4 月。

en: Never went anywhere without the dogs, yet the dogs were left behind.
Lummi Nation, Bellingham, Washington, January 20, 2025.
zh: 從不丟下狗獨自出門，狗卻被留了下來。
華盛頓州貝靈漢盧米族保留區，2025 年 1 月 20 日。

en: Floods of traffic allegedly knocked U.S. bank websites offline, 2011 to 2013.
An employee of Mersad; speaks Farsi.
zh: 據稱以大量流量癱瘓美國銀行網站，2011 至 2013 年。
Mersad 的員工；會說波斯語。

en: Allegedly broke into a Vermont defense contractor to steal its software.
Used borrowed servers to hide location; believed in Iran.
zh: 據稱闖入佛蒙特州一家國防承包商竊取其軟體。
利用他人伺服器隱藏位置；據信在伊朗。

en: Never showed up for work at a resort company; a person was filmed parking the car.
Orlando, Florida, January 24, 2006; Westgate Resorts, Ocoee.
zh: 沒去度假村公司上班；監視器拍到有人停好那輛車。
佛州奧蘭多，2006 年 1 月 24 日；奧科伊 Westgate Resorts。

en: Allegedly opened ATMs, planted code inside, and made them spit out cash.
Indicted in Houston; awaiting trial when fled.
zh: 據稱打開自動提款機，植入程式，讓機器吐出現金。
在休士頓被起訴；候審期間逃逸。

en: Drove from Denver to meet a partner at Walmart; the car sat in a hospital lot.
Pueblo, Colorado, February 4, 2013.
zh: 從丹佛開車去沃爾瑪見伴侶；車子後來停在醫院停車場。
科羅拉多州普韋布洛，2013 年 2 月 4 日。

en: Got into a vehicle one afternoon, believed headed to a nearby city.
Folcroft to Chester, Pennsylvania, August 28, 2025.
zh: 某天下午坐上一輛車，據信前往附近一座城市。
賓州福爾克羅夫特往切斯特，2025 年 8 月 28 日。

en: Indicted over a 1996 truck blast at a U.S. military housing complex.
Said to head the "military wing" of Saudi Hizballah.
zh: 因 1996 年美軍住宅區的卡車爆炸案被起訴。
據稱領導沙烏地真主黨的「軍事部門」。

en: Gone from the shared house sometime between midnight and 1 a.m.
Clark County, Washington, April 7, 2007.
zh: 午夜到凌晨 1 點之間，從同住的房子裡不見了。
華盛頓州克拉克郡，2007 年 4 月 7 日。

en: On foot to a restaurant shift, with plans to meet a friend at a high school.
Fazoli's and Benson High School, Omaha, Nebraska, June 13, 2001.
zh: 走路去餐廳上班，還約了朋友在一所高中碰面。
內布拉斯加州奧馬哈 Fazoli's 與 Benson 高中，2001 年 6 月 13 日。

en: Allegedly locked up victims' files and demanded payment, hitting non-profits and infrastructure.
2020–2022, indicted in Newark; one of three.
zh: 據稱鎖住受害者的檔案勒索付款，受害者包括非營利組織和基礎設施。
2020 至 2022 年，在紐華克被起訴；三人之一。

en: Fentanyl and meth allegedly packed into fire extinguishers in scrap metal loads.
Smuggled from Mexico; warrant from Los Angeles, December 2023.
zh: 芬太尼和冰毒據稱被塞進廢金屬貨物裡的滅火器。
從墨西哥走私；2023 年 12 月由洛杉磯發出拘票。

en: Military officers allegedly registered fake domains to interfere with the 2016 U.S. elections.
Unit 26165; indicted in D.C., July 13, 2018.
zh: 軍官據稱以假資料註冊網域，干預 2016 年美國大選。
26165 部隊；2018 年 7 月 13 日在華盛頓特區被起訴。

en: The car was in the town square the next day; wallet pieces surfaced years later.
Millersburg, Pennsylvania, August 5, 1989; Wiconisco Creek.
zh: 隔天車子出現在鎮廣場；錢包碎片多年後才被找到。
賓州米勒斯堡，1989 年 8 月 5 日；Wiconisco 溪。

en: Said they were heading to the store; later placed at a nearby apartment complex.
Nashville, Tennessee, July 27, 2003.
zh: 說要去商店；之後查出曾在附近一處公寓社區。
田納西州納什維爾，2003 年 7 月 27 日。

en: Cousins said goodnight; by morning, the outside bedroom door was unlocked.
Balmorhea, Texas, October 2, 2003.
zh: 表親們道了晚安；隔天早上，臥室通往戶外的門沒鎖。
德州巴爾莫赫亞，2003 年 10 月 2 日。

en: A Tesla Supercharger station was badly damaged by fire at 1:30 a.m.
Lacey, Washington, April 8, 2025; tips sought on the person seen.
zh: 一座特斯拉超級充電站在凌晨 1:30 遭火燒嚴重受損。
華盛頓州雷西，2025 年 4 月 8 日；徵求畫面中人的線索。

en: A 22-year-old parent of a young child, seen by an in-law; foul play suspected.
Tacoma, Washington, July 26, 1982; reported weeks later.
zh: 一名育有年幼孩子的 22 歲家長，姻親最後見到；疑涉不法。
華盛頓州塔科馬，1982 年 7 月 26 日；幾週後才報案。

en: Left a restaurant shift to hitchhike to relatives on an island.
Rainbow Restaurant, Natick, to Martha's Vineyard, Labor Day weekend 1977.
zh: 下班離開餐廳，要搭便車去島上的親戚家。
從內蒂克 Rainbow 餐廳前往瑪莎葡萄園島，1977 年勞動節週末。

en: Part of a heavily armed Sinaloa organization moving meth and other narcotics.
Said to be the uncle of the organization's leader, "El Chapo Isidro".
zh: 屬於錫那羅亞一個武裝精良、運送冰毒等毒品的組織。
據稱是組織首腦「El Chapo Isidro」的叔叔。

en: Co-founder of Tornado Cash, a cryptocurrency mixer for untraceable transfers.
Charged with running an unlicensed transmitting business; ties to Dubai and Moscow.
zh: Tornado Cash 共同創辦人，一個讓加密貨幣轉帳無法追蹤的混幣服務。
被控經營無照匯兌業務；與杜拜和莫斯科有關聯。

en: Spoofed emails allegedly tricked over 70 U.S. businesses into wiring payments.
Supplied accounts and ran advance-fee scams; Nigeria.
zh: 據稱以偽造電子郵件騙超過 70 家美國企業匯款。
提供帳戶並從事預付款詐騙；奈及利亞。

en: Took a 5:30 p.m. stroll from a family celebration; a search began 30 minutes later.
County Road 545, Little Lake, Michigan, June 14, 1997.
zh: 家族慶祝會上，下午 5 點半出去散步；30 分鐘後大家開始找人。
密西根州小湖鎮 545 號縣道，1997 年 6 月 14 日。

en: A man was confronted at a residence and died; an AK-47 was used.
DeKalb County, Georgia, July 2002; a construction worker.
zh: 一名男子在住處被找上門後喪命；使用的是 AK-47。
喬治亞州迪卡爾布郡，2002 年 7 月；建築工人。

en: Escaped Folsom State Prison in 1987, then later a prison in Guadalajara.
Was serving a long sentence; fluent in Spanish.
zh: 1987 年從福爾松州立監獄脫逃，後來又從瓜達拉哈拉的監獄逃走。
原本在服長期徒刑；西班牙語流利。

en: Fentanyl and meth allegedly packed into fire extinguishers in scrap metal loads.
The route ran from Mexico into the U.S.; one of several charged.
zh: 芬太尼和冰毒據稱被塞進廢金屬貨物裡的滅火器。
路線從墨西哥進入美國；數名被告之一。

en: Pandemic funds meant for children's meals were allegedly diverted.
Millions from the Federal Child Nutrition Program; may be in Somalia.
zh: 疫情期間要給孩子供餐的經費據稱被挪用。
聯邦兒童營養計畫的數百萬美元；可能在索馬利亞。

en: Set off for the school bus but never boarded it.
Nashville, Tennessee, April 29, 2003.
zh: 出門去搭校車，卻始終沒上車。
田納西州納什維爾，2003 年 4 月 29 日。

en: Fake ads allegedly scared people into buying over a million bogus software products.
Losses over $100 million; ties to Sweden.
zh: 據稱以假廣告嚇唬民眾購買超過一百萬套假軟體。
損失逾一億美元；與瑞典有關聯。

en: About two dozen Florida companies sold real estate investments to Americans and Europeans.
Sky Development Group; speaks German, Russian and English.
zh: 約二十多家佛州公司向美國人和歐洲人推銷房地產投資。
Sky Development Group；會說德語、俄語和英語。

en: One of 23 people charged after a 2004 Chicago-area narcotics inquiry.
Charged with conspiracy to distribute; has connections in Mexico.
zh: 2004 年芝加哥地區一項毒品調查後被起訴的 23 人之一。
被控共謀散布毒品；在墨西哥有人脈。

en: Three teenagers died in a convenience store the day after Christmas.
Garland, Texas, 2021; the person sought was 14 at the time.
zh: 聖誕節隔天，三名青少年在一家便利商店喪命。
德州加蘭，2021 年；被通緝者當時 14 歲。

en: Three men allegedly targeted 2024 presidential campaign staff for Iran's Revolutionary Guard.
Charged in Washington, D.C., September 2024.
zh: 三名男子據稱替伊朗革命衛隊鎖定 2024 年總統競選陣營人員。
2024 年 9 月在華盛頓特區被起訴。

en: Alleged North American leader of the Lawrence Bishnoi group.
The group is accused of extortion and political assassinations.
zh: 據稱是 Lawrence Bishnoi 集團在北美的首腦。
該集團被控勒索及暗殺政治人物。

en: Took out the trash; left behind a wallet and the bicycle used for getting around.
Waco, Texas, July 4, 2007.
zh: 出門倒垃圾；錢包和平常代步的腳踏車都留下了。
德州韋科，2007 年 7 月 4 日。

en: The FBI is helping a city police department search after a pre-dawn sighting.
Autumn Woods Drive, Trotwood, Ohio, December 27, 2022.
zh: FBI 正協助市警局搜尋，最後一次目擊是在凌晨。
俄亥俄州特羅特伍德 Autumn Woods 路，2022 年 12 月 27 日。

en: Fourteen workers allegedly earned and moved revenue for Pyongyang, 2017 to 2023.
Listed as a IT worker; charged in St. Louis.
zh: 十四名工作者據稱在 2017 至 2023 年替平壤賺取並轉移收入。
列為IT 工作者；在聖路易被起訴。

en: An American author researching a new book in a conflict region.
Khost City, Afghanistan, mid-May 2014.
zh: 一名美國作家，在衝突地區為新書做研究。
阿富汗霍斯特市，2014 年 5 月中旬。

en: A St. Petersburg agency allegedly ran fake American personas to sway U.S. politics.
Speaks Russian and English; ties to France.
zh: 聖彼得堡一家機構據稱經營假美國人身分，企圖左右美國政治。
會說俄語和英語；與法國有關聯。

en: That evening, the car was seen at a retirement home.
South Lierman Avenue, Urbana, Illinois, July 1990.
zh: 當天晚上，有人在一間退休安養社區看到那輛車。
伊利諾州厄巴納南 Lierman 大道，1990 年 7 月。

en: A parent and two-year-old set out on a move to Texas.
Hazel Park, Michigan, August 31, 1981; south on I-75 to San Antonio.
zh: 一位家長和兩歲孩子出發搬去德州。
密西根州黑澤爾帕克，1981 年 8 月 31 日；走 I-75 南下聖安東尼奧。

en: A man died in a Los Angeles bar; a business was then broken into.
February 1, 2006; previously lived in Bellflower.
zh: 一名男子在洛杉磯一間酒吧喪命；之後一家店遭闖入。
2006 年 2 月 1 日；曾住貝爾弗勞爾。

en: Chengdu 404 employees allegedly ran supply-chain attacks on hundreds of firms worldwide.
Known as BARIUM; charged with racketeering conspiracy in 2020.
zh: 成都 404 公司員工據稱對全球數百家企業發動供應鏈攻擊。
人稱 BARIUM；2020 年被控組織犯罪共謀。

en: Allegedly ordered acts of violence as a senior MS-13 leader.
Charged with narco-terrorism; activity spans three countries.
zh: 據稱以 MS-13 高層身分下令施暴。
被控毒品恐怖主義；活動橫跨三國。

en: State-backed programmers allegedly behind some of the costliest breaches in history.
North Korean; reported birth year 1989; traveled to China.
zh: 據稱是史上損失最慘重入侵事件背後的國家支持程式設計師。
北韓人；報稱 1989 年出生；去過中國。

en: Spearphishing emails and social engineering allegedly targeted U.S. companies and agencies.
Allegedly a network administrator who procured infrastructure.
zh: 據稱以魚叉式釣魚郵件和社交工程鎖定美國公司與機關。
據稱是網路管理員，負責採購設施。

en: Officials were allegedly sent secretly to the U.S. to pressure a fugitive to return home.
One of five; also charged with interstate harassment.
zh: 據稱秘密派官員到美國，施壓一名逃犯回國。
五人之一；另被控跨州騷擾。

en: Sought over a retired FBI agent who went to Kish Island and never returned.
Described as an Iranian state officer; March 2007.
zh: 因一名退休 FBI 探員前往基什島後再也沒回來而被找。
被描述為伊朗國家機構官員；2007 年 3 月。

en: Organized a blockchain and cryptocurrency conference held in Pyongyang.
A crypto businessperson living in the UAE.
zh: 籌辦一場在平壤舉行的區塊鏈與加密貨幣會議。
住在阿聯的加密貨幣商人。

en: A roommate died in a Boulder apartment; years later, an empty car turned up.
August 1983; the car was in Beverly Hills; may have lived in Yelapa.
zh: 一名室友在博德的公寓喪命；數年後，一輛空車被發現。
1983 年 8 月；車在比佛利山；可能住過耶拉帕。

en: Nicknamed "AJ"; the car turned up abandoned in a park across the street.
Bernard Street, Houma, Louisiana, August 28, 1991; Jim Bowie Park.
zh: 綽號「AJ」；車子被發現棄置在對街的公園。
路易斯安那州霍馬伯納德街，1991 年 8 月 28 日；Jim Bowie 公園。

en: Skipped a birthday party at a pizza place; the travel bag was at the house.
Downers Grove, Illinois, October 1, 2012.
zh: 沒出現在披薩店的生日派對；行李袋還在家裡。
伊利諾州唐納斯格羅夫，2012 年 10 月 1 日。

en: Sought over a retired FBI agent who went to Kish Island and never returned.
An official of Iran's MOIS, tied to an alleged cover-up.
zh: 因一名退休 FBI 探員前往基什島後再也沒回來而被找。
伊朗情報及安全部官員，涉及據稱的掩蓋行為。

en: Was supposed to take a Greyhound bus to Brownsville.
Homestead, Florida, September 18, 1984; had lived in Bonita Springs.
zh: 原本要搭灰狗巴士去布朗斯維爾。
佛州霍姆斯特德，1984 年 9 月 18 日；曾住在博尼塔斯普林斯。

en: Caught on fast-food restaurant video at 2:40 a.m. after a night at a bar.
Arby's, West Jefferson Boulevard, Fort Wayne, Indiana, December 8, 2018.
zh: 在酒吧待了一晚後，凌晨 2 點 40 分被速食店監視器拍到。
印第安納州韋恩堡西傑佛遜大道 Arby's，2018 年 12 月 8 日。

Indicted in Pittsburgh, October 3, 2018.
zh: 七人據稱入侵反禁藥機構和運動總會以散布假訊息。
2018 年 10 月 3 日在匹茲堡被起訴。

en: Convicted after a domestic-tagged felony arrest, then never showed in court.
Bellingham, Washington, 2023; ties to Tucson and Aurora.

華盛頓州貝靈漢，2023 年；與土桑和奧羅拉有關聯。

en: Reported days later; investigators believe foul play may be involved.
Plummer, Idaho, March 8, 1988.
zh: 幾天後才報案；調查人員認為可能涉及不法。
愛達荷州普盧默，1988 年 3 月 8 日。

en: An 11-year-old went into a mall alone while a parent waited in the parking lot.
Old Hickory Mall, Jackson, Tennessee, March 4, 2001.
zh: 一個 11 歲孩子獨自走進購物中心，家長在停車場等。
田納西州傑克遜 Old Hickory 購物中心，2001 年 3 月 4 日。

en: Victims nationwide were talked into mailing cash and prepaid debit cards.
A fuel station cashier, 2017–2021; moves between Illinois and Pennsylvania.
zh: 全美各地的受害者被說服寄出現金和預付卡。
加油站收銀員，2017 至 2021 年；往返伊利諾州和賓州。

en: A young son was taken from Tehachapi, California, in April 1997.
The charge is taking one's own child; Mexico is a possible destination.

罪名是帶走自己的孩子；可能去了墨西哥。

en: Allegedly stole data from 45 defense and tech firms, working with Tianjin state security.
Known by handles including "Godkiller" and "Afwar".
zh: 據稱與天津國安局合作，從 45 家國防和科技公司竊取資料。
使用的代號包括「Godkiller」和「Afwar」。

Unit 74455; charges include wire fraud; Moscow.
zh: 軍官據稱鎖定烏克蘭基礎設施、法國一場競選和喬治亞。
74455 部隊；罪名包括電匯詐欺；莫斯科。

en: Friends dropped the person off at an apartment complex at 11:45 p.m.
Fountaingate Apartments, Wichita Falls, Texas, May 10, 1997.
zh: 朋友晚上 11 點 45 分把人送到公寓社區。
德州威奇托福爾斯 Fountaingate 公寓，1997 年 5 月 10 日。

en: Fake social media personas allegedly lured current and former U.S. agency staff.
CEO of an entity working for the Revolutionary Guard.

一家替革命衛隊工作的機構的執行長。

en: Fourteen workers allegedly earned and moved revenue for Pyongyang, 2017 to 2023.
Listed as a group leader; charged in St. Louis.

列為組長；在聖路易被起訴。

en: A national MS-13 leader in Honduras who allegedly coordinated its narcotics business.
Charged with possessing machine guns; close to the Honduran top leader.

被控持有機關槍；與宏都拉斯最高首領關係密切。

Complaint unsealed May 21, 2003; last known in Yemen.

訴狀於 2003 年 5 月 21 日解封；最後已知在葉門。

en: Better known as "La Rana" (the Frog), running a plaza in Northern Baja.
Charged with narcoterrorism and a continuing criminal operation.
zh: 人稱「La Rana」（青蛙），掌控下加利福尼亞北部的地盤。
被控毒品恐怖主義及持續性犯罪經營。

en: Allegedly stole prized inbred corn seed lines from U.S. companies for a Chinese firm.
DuPont Pioneer and Monsanto seed; warrant from Iowa, 2013.

杜邦先鋒和孟山都的種子；愛荷華 2013 年發出拘票。

en: A ranking member of Colombia's ELN guerrilla group.
Charged with narco-terrorism over the Catatumbo region.

因卡塔通博地區的活動被控毒品恐怖主義。

en: Seen at the workplace around 9:30 p.m.; speaks Swedish.
Belmont, California, October 14, 1996.
zh: 晚上 9 點半左右在工作地點被看到；會說瑞典語。
加州貝爾蒙特，1996 年 10 月 14 日。

A Mabna Institute contractor; one of nine.
zh: 據稱從大學竊取研究成果並賣給德黑蘭。
Mabna 研究所的承包商；九人之一。

en: Allegedly sold digital images of fake passports for more than 200 countries.
SecondEye Solution, aka Forwarderz, in Karachi.
zh: 據稱販售超過 200 個國家的偽造護照數位圖檔。
喀拉蚩的 SecondEye Solution（又稱 Forwarderz）。

Fort Lauderdale, 2002–2006; believed to be in Australia.

勞德岱堡，2002 至 2006 年；據信在澳洲。

en: Indicted over the June 1985 seizure of a commercial airliner.
One U.S. citizen died; thought to be in Lebanon.
zh: 因 1985 年 6 月劫持一架民航客機被起訴。
一名美國公民喪生；據信在黎巴嫩。

en: Charged with premeditated first-degree homicide of a man in Hillsborough County.
Said to be a Latin Kings member working as a barber in Celaya, Mexico.
zh: 被控在希爾斯伯勒郡預謀一級殺害一名男子。
據稱是拉丁國王成員，在墨西哥塞拉亞當理髮師。

en: Government vehicles were broken into and items stolen after an incident with an officer.
North Minneapolis, around 7 p.m., January 14, 2026.
zh: 一起涉及執法人員的事件後，政府車輛遭破壞並被偷走物品。
明尼亞波利斯北區，2026 年 1 月 14 日晚上 7 點左右。

en: The last record is a traffic ticket; a grown child reported it 25 years later.
Waco, Texas, April 3, 1995.
zh: 最後的紀錄是一張交通罰單；25 年後成年子女才報案。
德州韋科，1995 年 4 月 3 日。

en: A tractor-trailer hauling precious metals was held up on a North Carolina highway.
Miami-to-Boston load, Wilson County, March 2015.
zh: 一輛載運貴金屬的聯結車在北卡羅來納公路上遭攔劫。
從邁阿密運往波士頓的貨，威爾遜郡，2015 年 3 月。

en: Promised members of a Laotian community partnerships in Las Vegas properties.
Several FDIC-insured banks were victims too; once owned a Lamborghini.
zh: 向寮國社群成員承諾合夥投資拉斯維加斯房產。
多家 FDIC 保險銀行也受害；曾擁有一輛藍寶堅尼。

en: Hundreds of kilograms of narcotics shipped from Colombia via Mexico to Canada.
Cocaine routed through Southern California; warrant issued September 2024.
zh: 數百公斤毒品從哥倫比亞經墨西哥運往加拿大。
古柯鹼途經南加州；2024 年 9 月發出拘票。

en: Convinced distressed homeowners to sign over their houses, promising help.
Pled guilty with a spouse in April 2009, then skipped court.
zh: 說服陷入困境的屋主交出房子，聲稱要幫他們改善財務。
2009 年 4 月與配偶一同認罪，之後沒出庭。

en: A Scottsdale family of three died and the house was then blown up.
April 2001; an avid hunter who once worked as a respiratory therapist.
zh: 斯科茨代爾一家三口喪命，房子隨後被炸毀。
2001 年 4 月；熱愛打獵，曾當過呼吸治療師。

en: Two siblings, ten and nine, waiting at a stop for the school bus.
As Tao village, Saipan, May 25, 2011.
zh: 兩名手足，十歲和九歲，在站牌等校車。
塞班島 As Tao 村，2011 年 5 月 25 日。

en: Rocks, concrete and electric scooters were hurled at patrol cars on a freeway.
Downtown Los Angeles, June 8, 2025; people in photos are being sought.
zh: 有人朝高速公路上的巡邏車丟石頭、水泥塊和電動滑板車。
洛杉磯市中心，2025 年 6 月 8 日；正在尋找照片中的人。

en: No contact with relatives or associates since early 2021.
Albuquerque, New Mexico, March 1, 2021.
zh: 自 2021 年初起就沒和親友或熟人聯絡。
新墨西哥州阿布奎基，2021 年 3 月 1 日。

en: Fourteen workers allegedly earned and moved revenue for Pyongyang, 2017 to 2023.
President of Yanbian Silverstar; charged in St. Louis.
zh: 十四名工作者據稱在 2017 至 2023 年替平壤賺取並轉移收入。
延邊 Silverstar 的總裁；在聖路易被起訴。

en: Hundreds of kilograms moved from Mexico through Los Angeles, bound for Canada.
Charged in Los Angeles in January 2024; listed age about 25.
zh: 數百公斤貨物從墨西哥經洛杉磯運往加拿大。
2024 年 1 月在洛杉磯被起訴；列出年齡約 25 歲。

en: A tire shop owner charged with automatic weapons and selling crack.
Warrant issued in San Juan, Puerto Rico, March 2026.
zh: 一名輪胎行老闆被控持有自動武器並販售快克。
2026 年 3 月在波多黎各聖胡安發出拘票。

en: Drove off at 5 p.m. in a sibling's silver 1989 Mazda 626.
Clifton, New Jersey, September 20, 1999.
zh: 下午 5 點開著手足的銀色 1989 年馬自達 626 離開。
紐澤西州克利夫頓，1999 年 9 月 20 日。

en: A child with a dime in a pocket who loved dogs.
Vineland, New Jersey, December 17, 1962.
zh: 一個口袋裡有一枚十分錢硬幣、很愛狗的孩子。
紐澤西州瓦恩蘭，1962 年 12 月 17 日。

en: Allegedly targeted American aerospace and satellite companies via social engineering.
One of three charged in D.C., 2020.
zh: 據稱以社交工程鎖定美國航太和衛星公司。
2020 年在華盛頓特區被起訴的三人之一。

en: The FBI and city police are asking about one late morning.
East 9th Street, Lumberton, North Carolina, 11:30 a.m., September 5, 2017.
zh: FBI 和市警局正打聽某天上午稍晚的情況。
北卡羅來納州蘭伯頓東 9 街，2017 年 9 月 5 日上午 11 點半。

en: A child reported by a parent; investigators suspect foul play.
Malcolm X Boulevard, Gary, Indiana, August 12, 2024.
zh: 一個孩子由家長報案；調查人員懷疑涉及不法。
印第安納州蓋瑞 Malcolm X 大道，2024 年 8 月 12 日。

en: A post-blast scene was found at a Baptist church; the people fled to a car.
First Works Baptist Church, El Monte, California, January 2021.
zh: 一座浸信會教堂被發現有爆炸後現場；相關人士逃上一輛車。
加州艾爾蒙地的 First Works 浸信會教堂，2021 年 1 月。

en: Officers of a Chinese military unit allegedly broke into six American companies' networks.
Unit 61398; the Western District of Pennsylvania case.
zh: 中國一支軍方單位的軍官，據稱侵入六家美國公司的網路。
61398 部隊；賓州西區聯邦法院的案子。

Plainfield, Illinois, April 30, 2007; may use a maiden name.
